Job Description
Job Requisition ID:  55568
Job Closing Date:  24 November 2026
Taunton, GBR, TA1 2UH **Contract Type:** Fixed-Term Apprenticeship, Full-time for 24 months
**Department:** BBC Radio Somerset
**Location:**  Taunton - BBC Somerset
**Salary:** £24,650 
## **COULD A BBC APPRENTICESHIP BE THE NEXT ROLE FOR YOU?**
Join us as an apprentice at the BBC to give yourself the opportunity to kick-start your career in a job you'll love. We’re committed to your skills and talent development. You’ll learn on-the-job, developing your knowledge and skills in an area that interests you, whilst working towards your apprenticeship qualification with one of our learning providers. 
## **WHY JOIN THIS SCHEME?**
The Junior Journalist Apprenticeship (JRA27) is perfect for curious and creative individuals with a passion for storytelling. Whether you're finishing school, college, or exploring an alternative to university, this programme offers an exciting opportunity to kick-start your journalism career with the world's leading public service media organisation.
You'll gain hands-on experience covering stories that matter to audiences, learning from experienced journalists and developing the skills needed to create trusted journalism.  
Alongside this, you’ll work towards both the NCTJ Diploma in Journalism and a Level 5 apprenticeship qualification.
**Want to find out more?** Watch recordings from our webinar series on our [Life at the BBC YouTube playlist](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQirbxfWHEPimmLiTI-yrGoMNMV1FRfWK&si=zN5oW9PAy2C6nmDQ) to learn more about this scheme and other opportunities we offer, and hear from current apprentices about their experiences.
## **YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT**
 As a Junior Journalist apprentice, this is a brilliant opportunity to learn, grow and contribute. On this team you can expect to: 
- Work alongside experienced journalists developing your skills while creating high-quality content.
- Get hands on experience including researching stories, booking guests and writing briefs.  
- Discover and develop compelling stories, assisting with interviews that bring important issues to life for diverse audiences.
- Learn from industry experts at the world's largest public service broadcaster.
You’ll study for your industry-recognised apprenticeship qualification, learning both on and off the job. 
This involves weekly virtual webinars + in-person bootcamps at PA Media Academy in London. 
You’ll cover a range of modules for the NCTJ Diploma including: 
- Media Law
- Essential Journalism
- Broadcast Journalism
- Journalism for a Digital Audience
- Video Journalism
Modules will be assessed through exams, coursework and a portfolio of work.  
For more information on what you will study during the scheme, please see the [Journalism Apprenticeship Standard](https://skillsengland.education.gov.uk/apprenticeships/st1516-v1-0).
## **YOUR SKILLS AND ELIGIBILITY**
We’re interested in your passion for working at the BBC and your enthusiasm for delivering world-class content and operational excellence to our audiences. We’re not focused on your qualifications; instead, we look for potential and offer you the opportunity to apply your transferable strengths and experience to work in different ways. 
If you can bring some of these skills and experiences, along with transferable strengths, we’d love to hear from you and encourage you to apply:
- You're naturally curious about people and what’s happening in the world around you, with a keen interest in news.
- You’re full of creative ideas and enjoy finding innovative ways to tell engaging stories.
- You love finding things out, asking questions and getting to the heart of a story.
- You have a real enthusiasm for writing and enjoy communicating complex ideas in a clear, compelling way.
- You thrive in a fast-paced environment, bringing flexibility, motivation and a willingness to adapt as priorities change.
This scheme is aimed at **non-graduates**. If you have a degree and you’re interested in similar roles at the BBC, we recommend applying for jobs at the [BBC careers site](https://careers.bbc.co.uk/) or having a look at our other apprenticeship schemes. 
## **ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA**
To be eligible for an apprenticeship at the BBC, you must: 
- Be 18 years old or over by the time the apprenticeship begins in September 2027.
- Have lived in the UK continuously for the last three years prior to the start of the apprenticeship.
- Be legally eligible to work full-time in the UK for the entire duration of the apprenticeship. 
- Not currently be enrolled in another apprenticeship programme, whether with the BBC or another organisation.
- Not already hold a qualification in the same subject area at the same or a higher level than this apprenticeship. 
 To apply for this scheme, you must also:
- Not have completed or be studying for the NCTJ diploma or a journalism qualification at the same level or higher.
- Have achieved English GCSE at Grade 4/C or above, or National 5 (Scotland) at C or Functional Skills Level 2 or equivalent qualification.
For candidates under the age of 19 years at the start of the apprenticeship: To complete the apprenticeship, you must have achieved Maths and English GCSE at Grade 4/C or above or National 5 (Scotland) at C or Functional Skills Level 2 or equivalent qualification to pass the apprenticeship.   
## **READY TO APPLY?**
Don’t leave yourself wondering “what if?” This could be your chance to be part of something exciting. See yourself thriving in this role? Just click ‘Apply Now’! 
You’ll create a candidate profile and answer a few questions - **no CV or cover letter needed.** 
If you're eligible, we’ll guide you through the next steps of the process and what to expect. 
You’ll need to live within a commutable distance of where this role is based. Interested in a different location? Check out our other adverts - but please only apply to one. The BBC recognises that you may need to relocate to a new location to take up a BBC Apprenticeship scheme. The cost of relocating can be a barrier for some applicants and where that is a barrier to participation, we want to help where we can. To help ensure our apprenticeship opportunities are accessible to people from a wide range of backgrounds, a limited number of relocation support awards are available each year for those who meet our financial eligibility criteria.  Relocation financial support is available for this role, subject to meeting the financial eligibility criteria. Further information will be shared with applicants during the recruitment process. Details on the wider support, initiatives and networks available at the BBC can be found on [our careers site.](https://www.bbc.co.uk/careers/bbc-life/inclusion/sed/)
This is a fixed-term apprenticeship - your contract lasts for the duration of the scheme. Once you have completed your apprenticeship, you will be able to apply for any suitable open vacancies at the BBC or outside in the wider creative industry. You’ll be supported with career development, employability training, and networking opportunities to help you take your next step.
For apprenticeship opportunities, disabled applicants who choose to apply under the Disability Confident Scheme and who meet the minimum criteria for the role will normally be progressed to the next stage of the recruitment process. For most of our campaigns, this would be an online assessment designed to assess your skills, motivations and suitability for the role.  Further details can be found in the [FAQs section of our careers site.](https://www.bbc.co.uk/careers/work/early-careers/faqs/#applicationguidance)
## Disclaimer
This job description is a written statement of the essential characteristics of the job, with its principal accountabilities, incorporating a note of the skills, knowledge and experience required for a satisfactory level of performance. This is not intended to be a complete, detailed account of all aspects of the duties involved.
Our apprenticeship roles are also subject to you having the require qualifications that we have deemed to be necessary for your role and the requirement of the training provider for your scheme.  The offer would be subject to you undergoing and meeting the requirements of a skill scan process with the BBC nominated training provider to determine your eligibility.
Please note: If you were to be offered this role, the BBC will conduct Employment screening checks which include Reference checks; Eligibility to work checks; and if applicable to the role, Safeguarding and Adverse media/Social media checks. Any offer made is conditional on these checks being satisfactory.
Before your start date, you may need to disclose any unspent convictions or police charges, in line with our Recruitment policy. This allows us to discuss any support you may need and assess any risks. Failure to disclose may result in the withdrawal of your offer.
We are unable to accept applications via CV and only applications made online will be considered. Please click on the APPLY NOW button to proceed with your application.
Information at a Glance
## This is your BBC
At the BBC you can create and innovate in an inclusive environment while contributing to some of the world’s best loved content, and the BBC’s mission to inform, educate and entertain.
[Find out more about the BBC](https://careers.bbc.co.uk/)
## Life at BBC
Here you will benefit from: •  Excellent career and professional development. •  Fair pay and flexible benefits including a competitive salary package, a 35-hour working week, 25 days annual leave (26 days for BBC Studios), a range of policies to support your work/life balance, a defined pension scheme and discounted dental, health care and gym. •  A values-based organisation where the way we do things is important as what we do.
As an Apprentice you will also receive: •  An industry recognised qualification. •  Industry-leading training through the BBC Academy and our learning providers (this may involve travel to locations across the UK). •  A dedicated Team Manager and Scheme Specialist to help with your development. •  Training and Mentoring by industry professionals.  •  A bespoke BBC apprenticeship experience including apprenticeship development days and membership of the BBC Apprenticeship community. •  Employability and networking training and support to help you secure your next role. •  The opportunity to apply for financial support for relocation subject to eligibility.
[Candidate pack](https://www.bbc.co.uk/academy/courses/ec-application/#/)
## You belong
We have a working environment where we value and respect every individual's unique contribution, so all our employees feel that they can belong, thrive and achieve their full potential.
We want to attract the broadest range of talented people to join us. The more diverse our workforce, the better able we are to respond to and reflect our audiences in all their diversity.
We welcome applications from individuals, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion and/or belief.
Find out more about diversity, inclusion and belonging in our strategy below.
[Diversity, inclusion & belonging strategy](https://www.bbc.co.uk/diversity/)
## Disability confident
We take inclusivity seriously and want to ensure all candidates who are disabled or have long-term health conditions receive the support and adjustments they need. If you need to discuss adjustments or access requirements for the recruitment process, or to carry out this role, please contact us via the [Early Careers Recruitment contact form](https://app.smartsheet.com/b/form/fb9285d0c9bb4ebaa7dc7d22615d8305?) and we’d be happy to discuss how we can support you through the process.

## **WHY JOIN THIS SCHEME?**
The Content Creator apprenticeship is designed to equip you with the skills to create engaging, impactful content across a range of platforms. You’ll learn how to plan and develop creative ideas, research target audiences, and produce audio, visual and written content suitable for different channels. 
This hands-on, immersive programme combines practical workshops, interactive sessions, assignments and collaborative group projects. You’ll gain experience in creating, recording and editing video and audio content, while developing your planning, presentation and pitching skills. The scheme also provides a foundation in photography and imaging, social media and search engine optimisation (SEO), and website creation, giving you a broad understanding of modern digital content production.
**Want to find out more?** Watch recordings from our webinar series on our [Life at the BBC YouTube playlist](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQirbxfWHEPimmLiTI-yrGoMNMV1FRfWK&si=eCgNZuWfnZICtWz1) to learn more about this scheme and other opportunities we offer, and hear from current apprentices about their experiences.
## **WHY JOIN THE TEAM?**
[BBC Radio York](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sounds/play/live/bbc_radio_york) operates a network of radio stations across England and the Channel Islands. From Truro to Newcastle, we are at the heart of the local community. Our services offer a trusted source of local news and information but we also celebrate everything that is great about where we live. Whilst our shows will primarily be studio-based, we are all about getting into the heart of the communities that we serve. We have a unique connection with our audience and love finding and sharing their stories. We’re also passionate about local sport, plus our ‘Make A Difference’ initiative is all about celebrating the people and organisations that make the areas we broadcast to, a great place to live.
## **YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT**
As a Content Creator apprentice, this is brilliant opportunity to learn, grow, and contribute – you could expect to:  
- Play a part in creating trusted, high-quality content for BBC audiences. 
- Grow your storytelling skills through hands-on experience researching, writing, producing and editing content on a range of subjects. 
- Develop your digital content skills by monitoring audience trends and creating content for social media platforms, including selecting and editing clips from programmes for use on social media platforms.  
- Spot opportunities for digital content, including short clips, behind-the-scenes moments, interviews and talent‑led extras. 
- Learn from experienced professionals, collaborate with expert teams and develop your career at the world's largest public service broadcaster. 
You’ll study for your industry recognised apprenticeship qualification, learning both on and off the job.  This means that as well as learning on your placement at the BBC, you’ll also attend learning blocks (up to a week at a time) with our learning provider, working towards an industry recognised apprenticeship qualification - Level 3 Content Creator.  
Learning blocks will be a mixture of in-person and virtual delivery, including attending instructor-led workships, tutorial sessions, presentations and group work.
For more information on what you will study during the scheme, please see the [Content Creator apprenticeship standard.](https://skillsengland.education.gov.uk/apprenticeships/st0105-v2-0) 
As part of the programme, you will be required to travel to attend in-person learning blocks and other apprenticeship-related activities where necessary.

We’re not focused on your qualifications; instead, we look for potential and offer you the opportunity to apply your transferable strengths and experience to work in different ways. 
If you can bring some of these skills and experiences, along with transferable strengths, we’d love to hear from you and encourage you to apply:
- Bring fresh, creative ideas for engaging and reaching new audiences.   
- A genuine consumer of content who follows what is happening across platforms like TikTok, YouTube and Instagram. 
- Adaptable and versatile, able to switch between serious, issue‑based content and fun, high-energy entertainment. 
- A collaborative team player who is organised, motivated, adaptable and thrive in a fast-paced environment. 
- Passionate about your own self-development, showing the discipline and commitment required to complete the apprenticeship. 
This scheme is aimed at **non-graduates.** If you have a degree and you’re interested in similar roles at the BBC, we recommend applying for jobs at the [BBC careers site](https://careers.bbc.co.uk/) or having a look at our other apprenticeship schemes.

To be eligible for an apprenticeship at the BBC, you must: 
- Be 18 years old or over by the time the apprenticeship begins in September 2027.
- Have lived in the UK continuously for the last three years prior to the start of the apprenticeship.
- Be legally eligible to work full-time in the UK for the entire duration of the apprenticeship.

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will enhance system reliability, observability and performance through a strong engineering approach and assist with incident resolution and best practices.
You will have strong software engineering skills, approaching system reliability and observability as a software problem — protecting, providing for, and progressing the performance and availability of our critical systems.
Using your engineering expertise, you will implement solutions that enhance reliability, including service instrumentation with OpenTelemetry and improved logging practices.
You will leverage AI tools and LLM platforms in your daily work to reduce toil, drive autonomous operations, and optimise system health, while engineering automation and tooling for effective service management.
Collaboration is key, working across multiple functions to embed reliability and observability best practices throughout the software development life cycle. Your contributions will ensure our systems meet user demands and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

Qualifications
Excellent knowledge of programming languages including Python, Golang and JavaScript.
Knowledge and experience of modern software development techniques and lifecycles.
Excellent knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, including the creation and management of effective Service Level Indicators (SLI's) and Service Level Objectives (SLO's) for reliability and customer satisfaction.
Knowledge of contemporary observability tools, techniques and best practice including Splunk, New Relic, Grafana and PagerDuty.
Proficiency in shell scripting for automation and system management tasks.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation and orchestration tools such as Ansible and Terraform.
Prior experience working in a large scale, 24/7 enterprise where system uptime and stability is of paramount importance to the business.
An AI-native engineering approach, with hands-on experience using LLM platforms and coding assistants to improve productivity and quality, and the ability to integrate AI-driven telemetry for advanced observability, predictive insights and root-cause analysis.
Additional Information
Developing and maintaining tools that facilitate effective management of our systems, ensuring they are operationally efficient and resilient.
Working with automation and orchestration platforms to automate manual activity and reduce toil.
Writing and contributing to code that enhances the reliability and observability of services, including telemetry, operational APIs and tooling.
Building sophisticated dashboards using a range of telemetry data and dash boarding technologies like Grafana, Splunk and New Relic.
Actively participating in live incident resolution and post-mortem analysis, providing effective remediation strategies to improve overall system health and prevent future issues.
Driving initiatives to enhance system reliability and observability, contributing to a culture of continuous improvement.
Maintaining and administering existing monitoring and analytic toolsets.
Mentoring colleagues in use of new technologies or practices.
Working with IT Operations to provide and support the use of critical tooling that will enable increasing levels of value to the Business.

About the role
This is the organisation's first dedicated security hire and is intended to grow into the seed of a security team over time. The role owns technical security operations and assurance, working closely with the Compliance Manager, who owns compliance programmes and external audits. It supports customer security questions and RFPs, and operates within the security direction set by the Head of Infrastructure.
Reporting line & team
The Information Security Manager owns the day-to-day review and coordination of the organisation's security operations — security incident review, vulnerability management, and client security assurance. The role combines hands-on technical work (triaging findings across the AWS estate and validating fixes) with coordination (tracking issues, driving remediation, and reporting on posture).
• Reports to the Head of Infrastructure.
• Partners with the Compliance Manager on compliance-related security work, providing technical security expertise, operational evidence and remediation updates.
• Collaborates with the Infrastructure and Engineering teams on platform security remediation, and with the external security advisory partner on specialist work.
• Drives corporate IT security improvements internally, coordinating with Thrive, Bipsync's external managed service provider, which has replaced the internal IT Manager function and implements the relevant IT changes.
• Individual contributor today, with scope to build out a dedicated security function as the organisation matures.
Responsibilities
Security operations — technical
• Review and triage security incidents across the AWS estate, coordinating response and escalating to the Head of Infrastructure where needed.
• Own vulnerability management: interpret output from security tooling and scanners, assess and prioritise findings, and validate that remediations are effective.
• Monitor security posture across the AWS platform and corporate IT environment, recommending improvements to controls, configuration, and tooling.
• Validate the effectiveness of corporate IT security changes implemented by Thrive.
Security operations — coordination
• Track security findings and remediation work to closure, driving action internally across Infrastructure, Engineering and other stakeholders, and coordinating with Thrive on corporate IT changes.
• Maintain visibility of open risks and report on security posture to the Head of Infrastructure.
• Define and track risk-based remediation priorities with the relevant teams and Thrive, escalating overdue or material risks to the Head of Infrastructure.
Client security assurance
• Support the Compliance Manager with the security content of RFPs and customer security questionnaires.
• Represent the organisation's security posture to customers and prospects on occasional security calls (limited exposure — a small number per year).
Governance & improvement
• Contribute to the ongoing improvement of security practices, standards, and tooling.
• Support ISO 27001 / SOC 2 activity with technical security expertise, operational evidence and remediation updates, working alongside the Compliance Manager, who retains ownership of compliance programmes and external audits, and the security advisory partner.
About you
You are a pragmatic, hands-on security professional who enjoys turning technical findings into practical improvements. You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues, influence action without relying on direct reports, and hold internal teams and external partners accountable for agreed remediation. You balance security risk with delivery needs, make proportionate recommendations, and know when to escalate. You are comfortable building a security function in a growing SaaS business while remaining close to the day-to-day technical work.
Requirements
• 5+ years of relevant information security experience, with demonstrated ownership of security operations and vulnerability management.
• Hands-on experience in a security operations, vulnerability management, or security engineering role, ideally in an AWS environment.
• Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech or supporting investment-management customers is beneficial.
• Security-related certifications — CISSP / CISM.
• Able to interpret output from cloud security tooling (e.g. GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector, or equivalent) and validate remediations.
• Experience triaging and coordinating security incidents.
• Comfortable supporting customer security assurance — questionnaires, RFPs, and occasional client-facing security calls.
• Exposure to ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2 from an operational / evidence standpoint.
• Self-starting and comfortable being the first dedicated security hire, with the ambition to grow the function.

• Enhanced parental leave and family-friendly benefits, including generous maternity and paternity leave.

• Training, mentoring and clear career progression opportunities.
• Monthly wellbeing allowance and access to a flexible benefits platform.
• Mental health, wellbeing and legal support services.
• Cycle to Work scheme.
• Home office budget and new-hire equipment package.
• Regular team lunches, social events and celebrations.

We are looking for a Project Manager to join our Professional Services team, helping non-profit organisations transform their operations through the successful implementation and adoption of Blackbaud solutions.
Reporting to the Professional Services Director, you will be accountable for the full project lifecycle, from initiation and planning through delivery, control and closure. You will manage multiple engagements, including complex enterprise implementations for some of Blackbaud’s highest-profile and most strategic customers.
You will establish effective project governance, maintain control of scope, budget, schedule and risk, and build trusted relationships with customer executives and project teams. You will also help customers prepare for change, adopt their Blackbaud solutions and realise the intended benefits.
As a senior member of the team, you will help develop consistent approaches to project delivery, adoption and value realisation. Some travel to customer sites in the UK, including occasional overnight stays, may be required.

Project management • Take overall responsibility for the successful delivery of complex technology implementation projects.
• Manage multiple Blackbaud Professional Services engagements concurrently, ranging from smaller prescriptive projects to enterprise implementations.

• Monitor delivery against agreed schedules, budgets and success measures, taking action where projects move off track.
• Proactively identify and manage project risks, issues, dependencies and escalations.
• Maintain effective control of project scope, budget, forecast and resource requirements.
• Identify work that falls outside the contracted scope and manage it through the appropriate change-control process.

• Support Sales with project scoping, estimation and delivery planning.
• Lead project kick-offs and represent Blackbaud in project boards, steering committees and other governance forums.
• Build trusted relationships with customer sponsors, executives and project teams.
• Lead customers and project teams through complex decisions, change and competing priorities.
• Provide clear and timely reporting to customers, internal stakeholders and senior management.
• Collaborate with Consulting, Sales, Customer Success, Product and Support to deliver a consistent customer experience.
• Provide guidance, coaching and support to members of the wider delivery team.
• Ensure project documentation is accurate, current and stored appropriately.
• Apply Blackbaud delivery methodologies and contribute to their continuous improvement.
Adoption & value realisation
• Design and execute structured adoption programs that move customers from onboarding to sustained, outcome‑based usage
• Drive customer alignment around benefits realisation, ensuring customers understand and achieve value from their Blackbaud solutions
• Accountable for driving adoption across the Professional Services portfolio through access to best practice tools, webinars and user groups in coordination with Customer Success Managers
• Reporting on outcomes from the program  
What we need from you
• Experience in at least one of the following: the non-profit or social-impact sector, or a customer-facing SaaS or software environment.

• Practical experience coordinating or managing customer projects, software implementations, onboarding programmes or Professional Services engagements.
• Strong customer and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to build relationships, manage expectations and guide customers through change.
• An organised and pragmatic approach, with experience balancing multiple projects or customer priorities and keeping delivery on track.
• Clear communication, sound judgement and a collaborative approach to working with teams such as Consulting, Customer Success, Sales, Product and Support.

Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working - across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop - down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on.
Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, Adanola and Huel use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform - and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.
The Role:
 Fospha is pioneering the future of marketing intelligence, moving enterprise retailers beyond the broken world of click-based attribution. Our mission is to transform complex data into the single, most trusted source of truth for CMOs and CFOs managing high-stakes budgets.
As a Marketing Science, your focus will be acting as the technical authority for our Enterprise tier, serving as a dedicated conduit between our Customers, Customer Teams, Data Science, and Product teams.
We are looking for a rigorous, analytical practitioner ready to operationalize advanced modelling into tangible business decisions, driving sustainable growth for clients like Huel, Dyson, and Gymshark. You will operate as a post-sales, value-delivery engine embedded directly within the Customer Success department.  
Key Responsibilities
• Client-Facing Support: Proactively and reactively support Customer Success and Account Management teams on model trust and methodology escalations, directly combating objections related to competitors like Triple Whale or Northbeam.
• Incrementality & Learning Agendas: Act as the primary Marketing Science Strategist, designing first-party incrementality tests, calibrating models, and building structured learning agendas for clients.
• R&D "Mouthpiece": Systematically capture and triage field feedback and methodological objections, feeding structured intelligence back to our Product and Data Science teams.
• Collateral & Knowledge Creation: Build the definitive technical collateral, Academy content, and internal training to raise the baseline data literacy of our entire Go-To-Market organization.
What are we looking for? We hire for potential - you should apply if you:
• Marketing Science Experience: 3-5 years of experience in marketing science, data analytics, or technical account management.
• Measurement & AdTech Knowledge: Deep understanding of Media Mix Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), incrementality testing, and the broader AdTech ecosystem, including Meta, Google, and TikTok.
• Commercial Translation: The rare ability to translate complex data science and Bayesian models into highly digestible commercial insights for non-technical executives.
• Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuasively to diverse audiences. Proven track record of working effectively in cross-functional teams. Ability to build consensus and drive alignment across diverse stakeholders.
• Problem-Solving Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing challenges. Ability to navigate ambiguity and make sound decisions under pressure.

job_description:
BNY Investments is a leading investment manager, with $2.2 Trillion in assets under management as of September 30, 2026. Through an investor-first approach, the firm brings to clients the best of both worlds: specialist expertise from seven specialist investment managers offering solutions across every major asset class, backed by the strength, stability, and global presence of BNY.
The Solution Design Team
The Solution Design team sits within Insight Investment and provides investment strategy and solutions expertise. The team works closely with Insight Investment's portfolio management teams, as well as Distribution colleagues across BNY Investments, to develop solutions for institutional clients.
The team has deep experience across Insight Investment's core capabilities, including liability-driven investment, risk management, full-spectrum fixed income and currency strategies, while increasingly drawing on investment capabilities from across the wider BNY Investments platform to meet evolving client needs.
The Role
We are seeking an experienced investment professional to join our Solution Design team in London at Vice President level, focussing in pooled fund clients and solutions. You will design and evolve investment solutions for existing and prospective institutional clients, working closely with investment teams, Distribution colleagues, clients and consultants.
The role combines investment strategy, portfolio analysis and client engagement. You will take ownership of solution design, contribute to the development of new investment propositions and represent the team in client, consultant and new business discussions.
In this role, you'll make an impact in the following ways:
• Design investment solutions for institutional clients, translating investment objectives, liabilities, constraints and risk considerations into practical portfolio strategies.
• Work directly with Distribution colleagues, clients and consultants to understand investment requirements and develop appropriate solutions.
• Lead and contribute to client and consultant meetings and new business pitches, owning investment analysis, recommendations and presentations.
• Analyse client portfolios and risk exposures, including portfolio analysis and asset-liability modelling, working with quantitative specialists where appropriate.
• Partner with portfolio managers and investment specialists to develop, implement and evolve pooled client strategies, including portfolio changes and transitions.
• Contribute to the development of new investment solutions and the evolution of existing propositions.

That someone could be you.

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. TEAM OVERVIEW
KKR's European Capital Solutions team sits within KKR's Credit & Markets platform and focuses on originating, underwriting, structuring and executing privately negotiated credit and hybrid capital investments across four complementary strategies:
Private Credit: Senior and junior debt strategies providing flexible financing solutions to high-quality upper middle-market and large-cap businesses, typically with EBITDA of €50m+, operating in resilient sectors with strong cash generation. Investments span the capital structure, including senior secured loans, second-lien debt, holdco PIK and preferred equity.
Strategic Investments: Flexible global strategy operating at the intersection of private equity and credit, providing bespoke capital solutions to mid-to-large-cap companies to facilitate growth. Investments combine equity upside participation with robust contractual downside protection, through structured minority equity, convertibles and other hybrid instruments.

Focuses on complex corporate transactions requiring differentiated financing and structuring solutions.
POSITION SUMMARY
KKR is seeking to hire Analysts and Associates to join its European Capital Solutions team in London.
The successful candidate will play an integral role in evaluating, executing and monitoring investments across the team's strategies, working closely with senior investment professionals in small deal teams.
The role offers an opportunity to gain broad investment experience across both credit and equity, with exposure to a variety of businesses, industries, transaction structures and risk-return profiles.
Analysts and Associates will be actively involved in all stages of the investment process, including financial modelling, company and industry research, due diligence, investment committee presentations, transaction execution and portfolio management. ClickHouse is the open-source, real-time analytical database behind a lot of today's AI. More than 4,000 companies build on ClickHouse, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Tesla and Meta.
As a Consulting Engineer, you're the hands-on engineer on our customers' most important projects. When a customer needs to migrate, integrate, or prove ClickHouse on a real workload, you work in the build alongside their engineers: you design it, build it, test it and hand it over.
You'll work on a broad mix of projects for customers across EMEA, from moving large workloads off other databases to building new real-time analytics on ClickHouse. Each one is scoped with clear goals from the start, so you know what success looks like and can get stuck in. It's a fast way to build deep experience across lots of different data problems.

- Turn customer goals into a scoped project with measurable success criteria, sizing and a timeline
- Design a target architecture and prove it against the customer's own data: schema and engine design, capacity and sizing, proofs of concept
- Do the build: implementation, pipelines and integrations, migration execution, tooling and automation

- You've owned implementations, migrations or POCs for external customers from start to finish

- You've deployed and run workloads on Kubernetes yourself
- You give precise technical answers and explain them clearly

Job Description
Collinson is the global leader in travel experiences and customer engagement, a business that builds loyalty 500 million times a day, across 140 countries, for some of the world's most ambitious brands. Our clients include major financial institutions, airlines, transport operators and retailers who trust us to design programmes that move customers from passive participation to genuine, measurable commitment.
Our loyalty practice sits at the intersection of behavioural strategy, data science and programme design. We believe that the best loyalty programmes are strategic assets - not cost centres - and we've built our methodology around the evidence: that incrementality, not points balances, is the true measure of a programme's worth.
Purpose of the job
This is a senior strategy role within our consulting business, with the opportunity to lead major client projects from discovery through to delivery. Working alongside the Experience Strategy Director, Loyalty Consulting, and wider strategy team, you’ll take ownership of strategic challenges, shape the direction of client programmes and be accountable for delivering work that makes a meaningful commercial and customer impact.
You’ll lead projects independently, champion the voice of the customer and bring together research, insight and data to uncover opportunities, challenge assumptions and develop compelling strategic recommendations. You’ll be confident setting the strategic agenda, navigating complex challenges and taking clients and colleagues with you.
This is a strategy role that takes data seriously. We are evidence-led in everything we do. The commercial case for a programme lives or dies on the quality of the insight behind it, and the strongest strategic thinking comes from a genuine understanding of what the numbers are saying. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you do need to know which questions to ask, how to interrogate the evidence and how to turn complex data into a clear, persuasive strategic argument.
Equally important is genuine curiosity and independent thinking. You’ll be someone who keeps asking why, digs deeper, connects the dots and brings fresh perspectives that challenge conventional thinking. You'll have the experience and confidence to lead client conversations, make informed strategic decisions and drive projects forward with autonomy, while knowing when to draw on the expertise of others.
As a senior member of the team, you'll also help shape and evolve our strategic thinking, approaches and capabilities. You'll stay close to developments in loyalty, customer engagement and behaviour change, bringing new thinking and fresh perspectives that strengthen our work, inspire colleagues and create opportunities for clients and prospects.

• Work with and enhance existing frameworks for programme evaluation including commercial modelling, incrementality modelling, headroom analysis, share-of-wallet assessment and behavioural segmentation

• Have a point of view on what good looks like: understand how the strongest long-term programmes (Clubcard, Avios, Nectar, others) have stayed relevant, how non-traditional models are working (M&S Sparks) and how that applies to the client and prospect challenges we are exploring

• Authentication, authorisation and accounting services.
• Identity management, directory and privileged-access integrations.
• Network observability, telemetry, logging and monitoring platforms.
• Network-management and automation services.

## The role in one line
A hands-on Lead Software Architect (≈ 80% building, 20% leading) who personally architects our core, drives and verifies AI-built code, and is the correctness backstop on the financial/risk algorithms — while leading a small team of three experienced engineers. This is a step-up opportunity for a strong senior developer or architect: the technical depth must already be there; the leadership is the growth.
## Mission
Build and own CE's AI-assisted software engineering: personally architect the core product, guarantee the correctness of the financial and risk logic, and set the standards and pipeline that let a small team deliver a lot with AI. Grow, over time, from a hands-on architect into the leader of CE's engineering.
## What you will do — hands-on (≈ 80%)
- **Architect the core yourself** — make and document the structural decisions for the platform and the product roadmap, and personally write and review the critical code.
- **Drive AI-assisted development on the hard work** — personally use AI coding tools (e.g. Claude) to build the core, and personally review their output on anything touching the financial/risk logic or the architecture.
- **Be the correctness backstop** — be hands-on with the actual algorithm code and prove it is structurally and numerically correct — not just plausible. Define and run the correctness checks.
- **Set the coding standards in code** — define the conventions, patterns and quality bar by writing and demonstrating them in the real codebase, and by reviewing against them.
- **Build the delivery pipeline & guardrails** — assemble and continuously improve the automated build/test/review pipeline and the review gates that make AI-assisted output trustworthy.
## What you will lead (≈ 20%)
- **Lead three experienced engineers** — set priorities and review gates, unblock them, and grow their AI-assisted-development capability. Light-touch; a builder, not a bureaucrat.
- **Sequence the product & innovation roadmap** — decide order and standards for new products and features — the team and the pipeline do the building.
- **Reduce key-person risk** — ensure the architecture and core logic are documented and codified so the organisation is not dependent on any single person.
## Please read this literally
If a candidate wants to stop coding and simply 'run a team', they are not right for this role. The person we want is happiest hands-on in the architecture and the code, and sees leading a small team as the growth step — not the job itself.
## Essential profile
- Proven architecture ownership of a non-trivial product in a correctness-critical domain (financial, trading, risk, ERP or similar). This depth is essential — it is the part of the role that cannot be learned on the job here.
- Genuinely hands-on and current: reads, writes and reviews production code daily, and is comfortable making AI coding tools (Claude or equivalent) do the heavy lifting under close supervision.
- Highly analytical and a strong problem-solver: comfortable reasoning about numerical/financial logic in a fintech environment, with the discipline to prove software is right, not just plausible. A good mathematical background is a plus, not a requirement.
- A fast learner who picks up new business domains and tools quickly.
- Ready for — and motivated by — a first formal leadership step over a small senior team; a builder, not a bureaucrat.
- Excellent English; able to work directly with the CEO and with client-facing colleagues.
## Desirable (not required)
- Experience with logistics or finance/fintech systems (ideally commodities/CTRM, treasury or trading systems).
- Experience introducing AI-assisted development into a real codebase.
- Experience documenting and codifying an expert's or founder's domain knowledge.
## What success looks like (first 12 months)
- The first pipeline stages are live and trustworthy (specification, development, unit test, code review) with clear review gates you defined.
- Coding standards and an architecture baseline are documented and followed by both the AI tooling and the engineers.
- No core-algorithm change ships without your correctness check.
- You have started to lead — the three engineers are more productive and more autonomous with AI than before.

Please send a short note on: your most significant architecture ownership, evidence of being genuinely hands-on today, and one example of proving a piece of software correct in a high-stakes context.

About [REDACTED]
The structural conflict at the centre of correspondent banking is not technological. It is economic. Banks earn revenue from their balance sheets: they lend deposits, capture FX spreads, and hold funds as long as it is rational to do so. Clearing, the act of releasing funds quickly and predictably, competes directly with those economics. An institution designed to lend has a structural incentive to hold deposits; an institution designed to clear has an incentive to release them. When one institution does both, clearing loses. The result is unpredictable settlement, trapped capital, and a correspondent network shrinking by design.
Why [REDACTED]
[REDACTED] was founded on a different premise: clearing as the business, not a byproduct. The model has been operational since 2023 and grew 55x in 2025, with USD clearing now the majority of volumes alongside a growing treasury offering. The role

Job Description:
We have a new vacancy for a Senior Design Engineer, predominantly based at our Head Office in Shipley.
About CMbE
CarnaudMetalbox Engineering (CMbE) designs, develops, and manufactures high-performance metal forming and finishing machinery for the production of beverage, food, and aerosol cans. With our commitment to innovation and precision engineering, it is an exciting time to join our business. CMbE offers you the opportunity to grow and develop your skills in an expanding industry.
Your mission in CMbE
The successful candidate will act as a project design authority, responsible for the delivery of project technical solutions. This role is responsible for generating technical requirements from customers and product specifications; generating design concepts for solutions to specific functional requirements; and evaluating design concept technical and project risks to select preferred solutions. This role is also responsible for documenting design concept assumptions, design trade-offs and calculations within the project design file. The successful candidate will be involved in peer reviewing technical content for gate reviews across projects, identifying opportunities for the protection of design Intellectual Property (IP), and generating test plans to verify design concept and system performance. Occasional travel is required for this role.
Experience leading technical projects is crucial for this role. Primary duties will include, but are not limited to, co-ordinating with the quality department to define incoming inspection requirements to verify component quality; preparing and presenting technical reports for project gate reviews; and contributing to planning design activities with the project manager. The ideal candidate will have experience in contributing to the continuous improvement of the NPD process. The candidate will be able to demonstrate their ability to capture project technical risks and issues throughout the project lifecycle. This role is also responsible for providing technical support to the publications department for the creation of product manuals, build books, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s).
Essential to this role is knowledge of material properties and standards; geometric dimensioning and tolerance principles and standards (ISO); machining methods and techniques; and configuration management (BOM) and Material Resource Planning (MSO) packages. The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate sound knowledge and experience of CAD systems to generate models and drawings.
The ideal candidate will be able to demonstrate technical knowledge of sensor technologies/solutions; electrical drive systems; mechanical transmission systems; and hydraulic, pneumatic and lubrication systems. Technical knowledge of packaging machinery is desirable.
About you
Candidates must hold a formal technical qualification to degree level, or equivalent, in a Mechanical Engineering discipline. The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate excellent communication skills to communicate technical information with various stakeholders; together with strong verbal and written skills, problem solving skills, the ability to work effectively within, and across, project teams and be highly organised with a high level of attention to detail. The ideal candidate will be able to demonstrate a high quality of work, adaptability, and think strategically.
What CMbE Offers You
• The opportunity to build a career in a multi-cultural environment
• To be rewarded fairly and promoted based on merit and performance • Professional and personal development through training and work experiences • Strong engagement and commitment to the safety of our employees
Join us and become part of an international team of professionals across the Crown packaging group who are passionate about precision engineering, can making machinery and sustainable packaging!

More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.
COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM
At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.
Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.
Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.
THE OPPORTUNITY
Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.
THE ROLE
Deepgram is currently looking for an experienced researcher to who has worked extensively with Large Language Models (LLMS) and has a deep understanding of transformer architecture to join our Research Staff. As a Member of the Research Staff, this individual should have extensive experience working on the hard technical aspects of LLMs, such as data curation, distributed large-scale training, optimization of transformer architecture, and Reinforcement Learning (RL) training.

We are seeking researchers who:
- See "unsolved" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approaches

Role/Team overview This role sits within the Distribution team under Sky’s Commercial Partnerships Group, which is an integrated group that includes our Content Partnerships, Connectivity, and Distribution teams and holds responsibilities across all Sky territories. The Content Distribution team is responsible for managing agreements that generate annual revenues of hundreds of millions of dollars through the distribution of our wholly owned content and services to any non-Sky platforms.
Responsible for supporting the distribution of Sky’s Apps across streaming device partners in the UK & Europe, ensuring wide distribution of Sky’s content to consumers to drive subscription growth for each Sky App business.
In joining the Content Distribution team, you will manage and support a portfolio of projects and deals to deliver our strategic distribution objectives across Sky territories.We negotiate and manage some of Sky’s most valuable contracts, balancing complete strategic, financial and regulatory considerations. The core responsibility of the Distribution team is to drive the strategic distribution of:
• Sky’s Apps & TV Channels - including NOW, Sky Go, and Sky Store – to major third-party platforms in the UK & Europe
• Partners include Apple, Amazon, Google TV, LG, Samsung, Hisense, Roku, PlayStation and Xbox
• Sky’s FAST Channels in the UK, in partnership with third-party FAST platforms
What you’ll do • Lead and develop strategic relationships with global device partners
• Support the negotiation, renewal and ongoing management of commercial partnership agreements.
• Identify new partnership opportunities and help build compelling business cases to unlock growth
• Manage partner relationships throughout the deal lifecycle, including commercial, proposition and pricing changes
• Collaborate closely with NOW/CCO and Global Streaming Platform teams to represent Distribution priorities and drive business outcomes
• Support the delivery of major technical initiatives, product launches and feature integrations across partner platforms
• Build strong relationships across Sky, working with teams including Product, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Technology, Content, and Strategy
• Use commercial insights, performance data and partner reporting to support decision-making, negotiations and long-term partnership success
What you’ll bring Essential criteria: • Experience managing strategic partner relationships
• Experience negotiating and managing commercial agreements
• Strong understanding of the European and North American media and technology sectors
• Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across multiple business areas
• Financial and analytical capability, including business case development and commercial evaluation
Desirable skills and experience:
• Detailed understanding of the OTT and streaming market across Europe
• Experience working for a multinational organisation on multi-territory deals
• Knowledge of major OTT service providers, connected TV platforms and device ecosystems
• Experience within media, entertainment, technology or consumer electronics industries
• Experience supporting new product launches, platform integrations or distribution partnerships
Benefits and perks
There's one thing people can't stop talking about when it comes to life at Sky: the perks. Here’s a taster:
• Free Sky TV or NOW package, including Sky Sports and Sky Cinema
• Pension package with up to 9% employer contribution
• Private healthcare with mental health support
• Aviva Digital GP and dental insurance
• Discounts on Sky products, including Sky Mobile, Sky Broadband, Sky Glass and Sky Protect
• Sharesave and Tech schemes
• A range of Sky VIP rewards and experiences
How you’ll work We've adopted a hybrid working approach to give more flexibility on where and how we work. The hybrid working expectations for this role are 3 days in the office per week.
Your office base Osterley
Who we are We’re Sky, a leading media and entertainment company who connect millions with entertainment, sports, news and arts through innovative products and services. Working with us means you’ll be bringing the joy of a better experience to more people, every day. All so we can do better and deliver better for our customers, colleagues and society.
We’re an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We're a Disability Confident Accredited Employer, and welcome and encourage applications from all candidates. We will look to ensure a fair and consistent experience for all and will make reasonable adjustments to support you where appropriate. Please flag any adjustments you need as early as you can.
Just so you know: if your application is successful, we’ll ask you to complete a criminal record check. And depending on the role you have applied for and the nature of any convictions you may have, we might have to withdraw the offer.
To be eligible for this role you are required to have the appropriate right to work in the UK. Please be aware Sky does not offer sponsorship for this position.

As a Financial Systems Engineer, you will be part of Business Systems Engineering, a group of several teams that builds and runs the systems the company operates on. This role is based remotely in the United States (Eastern time zone), the UK, or Ireland.
Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers are operating in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.
Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multi-cloud problems and drive efficiency.
With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Ingram Micro, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.
The Opportunity
We are modernizing how we run our financial systems and bringing this work in-house, and we're looking for a Financial Systems Engineer to own it. You will own our financial systems - NetSuite today, with FloQast coming online - as an engineer, not just an administrator.
What sets this role apart is mindset. You are the kind of person who is averse to doing the same manual task twice and instinctively looks for ways to automate it away. You will own the configuration and business logic of the financial systems, keeping each one doing what it does best, and partner with our internal engineering team on cross-system integration rather than wiring it together by hand.
This is a high-ownership role serving Finance and Accounting directly. You will be their dedicated systems partner - someone who knows the platforms deeply, is invested in making them better, and treats reducing manual, error-prone work as the core of the job rather than something to do on the side. Reporting to the Manager of Enterprise Systems, you will have real room to shape how finance operations run as the company scales
Responsibilities
• Own and administer our core financial systems - NetSuite today, with FloQast coming online - including configuration, business logic, and day-to-day system health.
• Identify manual, recurring, or error-prone finance operations (month-end close, reconciliations, reporting, procure-to-pay) and reduce or remove them through automation, choosing the simplest effective approach and partnering with engineering for heavier builds.
• Serve as the business-logic and data expert for the finance domain, partnering with engineering to define and maintain the rules and canonical definitions the systems rely on.
• Build cross-system integrations on a central, version-controlled, observable integration platform in partnership with engineering, rather than as one-off scripts buried inside individual tools.
• Act as the dedicated systems partner to Finance and Accounting: translate their needs into system capability, own those working relationships, and serve as the technical owner for financial-vendor onboarding, configuration, and administration.
• Use modern AI tooling to draft automations and accelerate routine system work, amplifying your output rather than adding manual effort.
Qualifications
• 3-6 years administering a financial or ERP system, with hands-on NetSuite administration required, including:
• configuration, customization, user access, roles, permissions, and workflows;
• core modules such as General Ledger, Advanced Revenue Management, Accounts, and subsidiary / multi-location structures;
• designing and implementing custom records, fields, and automations;
• building SuiteFlow automations in response to changing business needs;
• managing the NetSuite integration ecosystem.
• A working understanding of core finance and accounting processes: month-end close, reconciliation, accounts payable / procure-to-pay, and revenue.
• A strong drive to eliminate repetitive manual work, with a demonstrated track record of automating it (e.g. scripting, saved searches, workflow automation, or low-code/iPaaS tools).
• Sound judgment about where logic belongs - what should be system configuration, what should be a cross-system integration, and which system is the source of truth for a given piece of data.
• Comfort with at least one of SuiteScript, SQL, general scripting, or API-based automation, and the ability to read and reason about integrations even when engineering builds them.
• Strong collaboration and communication across both finance and engineering teams, with the ability to translate between them.
• Fluent English; knowledge of any other language is an advantage.
Bonus Points:
• FloQast administration experience.
• Experience working against a central integration platform or in an event-driven environment.
• Comfort using AI coding and automation tools in day-to-day work.
• Depth in SuiteScript (1.0 / 2.0), RESTlets, or NetSuite web services.

Experience scaling metadata management systems, such as data catalogs or lineage tracking systems, that span multiple storage and compute technologies. Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs, including consistency, fault tolerance, concurrency, partitioning, and recovery from partial failures. Strong technical judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritize competing needs, deliver incrementally in a fast-paced trading environment, and develop other engineers. Location: Remote, UK based
Type: Permanent, Full-Time 37.5 hours per week
Velonetic represents the joint ventures between DXC Technology, the International Underwriting Association (IUA), and Lloyd’s of London. Previously referred to as the London Market Joint Ventures, we have been operating for over 20 years in the London market (Lloyd's and Company), in both insurance and reinsurance business. Processing over £101 billion worth of premium and claims transactions today, we are building a new digital platform and services that will enable our customers to move transactions and money through the processing lifecycle with greater efficiency and speed, releasing time to drive innovation and focus on higher value activities. Our core business services involve performing checks on insurance documents, processing premium transactions and processing claims transactions.
Individual will reside in the UK and have Right to Work in the UK.
Job Overview
This is an exciting opportunity for someone with good communication skills and an eye for detail that enjoys being part of an enthusiastic and determined team. The Velonetic Bid and Proposal Lead is the single point of contact to the Sales lead for all activity required to develop and publish a compelling client proposal from pursuit strategy and proposal development to content creation and editing. The Bid and Proposal Lead role is typically involved in all formal bid submissions required by Velonetic. They engage in the request for information (RFI) and request for proposal (RFP) stages and assist with, or lead, the creation of messaging collateral. After the arrival of the RFP, The Bid and Proposal Lead is responsible for the effective operation of the Bid team, developing the bid plan, which includes at a minimum adherence to required stages of Velonetic governance and that encompasses a dedicated plan to produce and deliver the proposal document, applying industry best practice throughout.
They must understand the business context of the opportunity and the essence of the Velonetic offering, messaging, solution, differentiators and win themes. Success in the role is based on understanding the client, their industry and their drivers for coming to market and then eliciting and translating the Velonetic perspective into a client-oriented story through the proposal, orals, and any other written collateral.
The Bid and Proposal Lead is also responsible for working with the Bid Team and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to provide guidance and coaching on how to deliver the messaging and story for maximum client impact and differentiation against any competitors. They should also be able to provide writing support to the rest of the pursuit members, covering all proposal tasks including strategy, messaging, Executive Summary, managing the proposal production and writing.
What you will be doing
Pursuit Strategy
• Supports proposal strategy development and other planning activities that help the Bid team plan and shape client deliverables
• Determines the right proposal resource mix and engagement plan based on complexity of the deal
• Builds trusted relationships with key stakeholders (Sales, Delivery, product management, legal, pricing) to identify and capture proposal inputs • Leads Proposal Storyboarding by actively participating in strategy sessions for example, Client Solution Strategy, Solution Design Workshops
• Facilitates and owns development of the Message Map
• Supports and guides the Sales Lead to develop the opportunity Executive Summary
• Ensures consistency of messaging across all proposal deliverables, for example, proposal documents, orals session slides
• Provides ongoing leadership and guidance to the Bid team throughout the proposal life cycle
Proposal Development
• Leads kick off meetings, regular deal review forums, and working sessions
• Researches the client organisation, its media, marketing, and approach to articulate what the client organization stands for; knows the client graphic and written style; and briefs and coaches the team on the client’s ‘hot buttons’
• Actively works to clarify the meaning of proposal content with team members to ensure consistency of core messages
Proposal Management
• Analyses RFx/bid requirements and tailors the proposal structure to ensure compliance and responsiveness to the client’s evaluation criteria
• Oversees the proposal development process including initial proposal content creation and design, and production of graphics, quality reviews, and production
• Develops proposal production plan and communicates with support areas for efficient execution
• Sets up file structure in SharePoint for proposal files
• Ensures writers understand RFP requirements and meet proposal deadlines
• I able to use relevant AI packages to efficiently produce content from existing collateral, in both text and graphical formats.
• Ensures proposal best practices are followed and delivers completed written proposal responses against agreed RFP deadlines, escalating issues as required
• Tracks the status of each proposal deliverable and escalates issues in a timely manner
• Uses Velonetic branded proposal-related tools, templates, and packaging
• Plans and conducts quality reviews and applies changes required
• Leads the production team to produce, quality check, and deliver the final documents
• Delivers a quality and complete proposal, on time
Content Creation
• Collaborates effectively with all relevant stakeholders to populate and update content
• Partners with the sales lead for the content and approach to the Executive Summary and other client communications, assisting sales and deal leaders to ensure maximum impact in each communication opportunity
• Identifies and re-works pre-written content as relevant to client-specific requirements
• Proofreads and edits content written by SMEs to ensure that it is compelling and convincing, that messaging and win themes are followed and to achieve "One Voice“ throughout all proposal deliverables
• Balances the need to develop an optimal proposal (client story, proposal language, and presentation) with the flexibility to adapt in the interests of timely delivery
• Actively works to clarify the meaning of proposal content with team members, given the diversity of specialisations and styles in the team, working with them to revisit and ensure consistency of core messages
• Researches the client organisation, its media, marketing and approach, to articulate what the client organisation stands for; knows the client graphic and written style; and briefs and coaches the team on the client’s ‘hot buttons’
What we’re looking for
· A successful candidate for this position is likely to have a university degree or similar qualification
· The candidate should have excellent written English and good spoken English.
· Experience of several years writing commercial or proposal documents, or in a similar writing capacity
· Experience of managing and delivering proposals within large pursuit teams, coordinating the delivery on-time of content from a number of different authors.
· A general understanding of the technicalities behind the solutions being described will be very useful. Failing this an ability to understand technical solutions rapidly and describe them accurately will be essential

The role
We're looking for a Senior ML Systems Engineer to join Encord's in-house ML team. This is a software-engineering-first role for someone with real machine learning deployment experience: you'll design, build and run the infrastructure that serves our computer vision and multimodal models in production.
 
Our platform is moving from manual, GUI-heavy annotation towards ML-driven workflows, where models do more of the work and learn from annotator feedback. Your job is to make that possible by turning our models into fast, dependable product features.

- Taking agentic QC to production. Turning quality-control agents that check multimodal outputs against a customer's ontology from a research prototype into a dependable platform feature.
- One integration, many workflows. Building model integrations that hold up across customers' custom, fast-changing ontologies and task templates, instead of one-off implementations.

- Design, build and operate model-serving and inference infrastructure for transformer-based vision and multimodal models
- Own the serving architecture behind our ML features, justifying trade-offs in latency, throughput, reliability and GPU cost

- Integrate models into Encord's product and annotation workflows together with Product Engineering
- Build reusable abstractions that work across models, data types, customers and changing task templates
- Set up monitoring and observability, and own performance and reliability once features are live

The Risk Management Function is central to Enstar’s governance and decision-making. It supports key regulatory and business deliverables, including solvency assessments, model validation, risk reporting and independent reviews of strategic initiatives and transactions. Reporting to the Head of Insurance, Model and Transaction Risk & EMAL CRO, the Insurance Risk Manager is responsible for leading the delivery of material insurance and model risk activities, translating detailed analysis into independent second-line conclusions and recommendations. The role manages defined areas of the Insurance Risk plan, exercises judgement over the scope and depth of reviews, and escalates material matters to the Head of Insurance & Model Risk.
The successful candidate will lead significant workstreams with limited supervision, determine the appropriate analytical approach within agreed parameters, and be accountable for the quality and timely delivery of conclusions and recommendations. The role will coordinate input from analysts and subject matter experts and will escalate material judgements, limitations and differences of view to the Head of Insurance & Model Risk. Insurance risk includes capital adequacy, reserving, underwriting and reinsurance credit risk. The role requires strong quantitative judgement, a practical understanding of insurance and actuarial matters, and the ability to convert detailed analysis into concise conclusions and recommendations.
What you will be doing:
Insurance Risk Management
- Manage the delivery of agreed components of the Insurance Risk plan, working closely with the Head of Insurance & Model Risk, entity CROs and regional risk teams.
- Independently assess capital adequacy, reserving, underwriting and reinsurance credit risks, identifying material issues and providing proportionate, evidence-based challenge to the first line.
- Manage quarterly second-line reviews of reserving movements, concentrations and emerging experience, including setting the review scope, coordinating analysis, challenging key assumptions, reviewing supporting work and recommending matters for escalation.
- Maintain insurance risk monitoring and reporting against the approved risk appetite framework, recommend enhancements to metrics and thresholds, and escalate where required.
- Plan and lead deep-dive reviews into material or emerging insurance risk topics, agreeing scope, completing analysis and presenting practical recommendations.
- Support the development of the Insurance and Model Risk frameworks, policies and standards, and manage their implementation and consistent application across assigned activities.
Model Risk Management
- Plan and lead model validation workstreams covering internal capital, reserving, forecasting and other material financial models, including review of data, methodology, calibration, implementation, controls and outputs.
- Determine the detailed testing approach for assigned validations, review testing performed by analysts and form initial findings and recommendations for escalation.
- Implement and monitor the Model Risk Management framework across assigned activities, maintaining relevant model inventory, classification, validation-planning and issue-tracking information and recommending enhancements as necessary.
- Coordinate with model owners, subject matter experts and external validators, following findings through to agreed resolution and escalation where required.
- Support validation activity linked to Lloyd’s and other regulatory submissions, ensuring work is well evidenced and delivered to required standards and deadlines.
Transactions and Strategic Initiatives
- Lead assigned Insurance and Model Risk workstreams within transaction reviews, coordinating analysis and specialist input and escalating material issues as needed.
- Assess complex or unfamiliar structures using relevant actuarial and financial analysis, identifying key assumptions, downside exposures and areas for further challenge.
- Prepare concise risk opinions and recommendations for senior management, committees and Boards, ensuring conclusions are supported by clear evidence.
- Monitor completed transactions against original expectations and identify material changes in the risk profile.
Stress and scenario testing
- Lead individual stress and scenario-testing exercises within the methodology and agreed priorities, including coordinating inputs, reviewing assumptions and outputs, and recommending conclusions.
- Review the reasonableness of scenario assumptions, dependencies and results, and recommend conclusions, management implications and areas for further investigation.
- Help enhance in-house scenario tools, documentation, governance and workshop materials, improving the consistency and efficiency of the process.

- Present technical analysis and risk conclusions to senior stakeholders, adapting the level of detail to the audience and responding constructively to challenge.
- Review and challenge validation analysis produced by analysts, ensuring that findings are proportionate, evidence-based and clearly articulated for the relevant stakeholders.
- Build effective working relationships across Risk, Actuarial, Finance, Investments, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit and transaction teams, while maintaining second-line independence.
- Manage discrete projects, priorities and dependencies to deliver accurate work within tight deadlines.

- Act as a pragmatic second line advisor, offering timely second opinions and clear recommendations across a wide range of stakeholder queries.
- Take a continuous improvement approach, helping evolve processes, outputs and responsibilities over time in line with business needs and professional development.
