# Careers: Casting
Esports casting is more than just talking over a game—it’s an essential part of the experience that brings energy, context, and emotion to every match. Whether you’re watching a nail-biting final in the **Welsh Esports League** or a community showdown at a local event, a great caster can make the difference between a memorable match and one you quickly forget.
At **Esports Wales**, casting plays a key role in building our growing community and showcasing the incredible talent in the region. In this post, we’ll explore what it means to be an esports caster, how to get started, and why it’s a fantastic way to contribute to the esports scene in Wales.
---
## What is an Esports Caster?
An esports caster—often compared to a sports commentator—provides live commentary for esports matches. They help the audience follow the action, offer insights into strategy, and build excitement with their voice and personality.
There are two main types of casters:
- **Play-by-Play (PBP) Casters**: Focus on narrating the action as it happens, bringing energy and emotion to key moments.
- **Colour Casters**: Provide in-depth analysis, breaking down strategies and explaining player decisions to give the audience a deeper understanding of the game.
In many cases, a casting duo combines both roles to create a balanced and engaging broadcast.
---
## Why Casting is Crucial for Esports
Casting helps **tell the story** of each game, giving context to the gameplay and connecting viewers to the players. For grassroots leagues like the **Welsh Esports League**, it creates an elevated experience that gives players a taste of what it’s like to compete on a bigger stage. Good casting also builds communities by turning matches into shared experiences, where fans can learn, laugh, and celebrate together.
---
## How to Get Started as an Esports Caster
If you’re passionate about esports and love the idea of being the voice behind the action, casting could be for you! Here are some tips to get started:
1. **Choose Your Game** Focus on a game you know well. Whether it’s **Rocket League**, **Overwatch 2**, or **League of Legends**, understanding the meta and gameplay mechanics is key to delivering insightful commentary.
2. **Watch and Learn** Study professional casters on Twitch or YouTube. Pay attention to how they build hype, manage pacing, and balance analysis with excitement.
3. **Practice, Practice, Practice** Record yourself casting replays of matches. Listen back to improve your delivery, timing, and knowledge.
4. **Build a Portfolio** Share your work online and look for opportunities to cast small tournaments or local events. Esports Wales often runs community events that are great for newcomers to get experience!
5. **Join the Esports Wales Community** We’re always looking to grow our network of Welsh talent. Reach out if you want to get involved as a volunteer or professional caster!
---
## Opportunities for Casters in Wales
Esports in Wales is growing rapidly, and there’s a huge demand for new talent across multiple games. From casting for the **Welsh Esports League** to helping with **Esports Wales Academy** workshops, there’s no better time to get involved. Casting can also lead to other exciting opportunities, such as hosting live events, creating esports content, or even joining larger international broadcasts.

### What is Physiotherapy in Esports?
Physiotherapy is a healthcare profession that focuses on the prevention, assessment, and treatment of movement disorders. In esports, physiotherapists play a crucial role in helping players maintain their physical health and performance.
The work of a physiotherapist in esports involves a range of tasks, including:
1. Injury prevention: Physiotherapists work with players to assess and prevent potential injuries that can occur from sitting in the same position for long periods or from repetitive motions.
2. Injury assessment: In the event of an injury, a physiotherapist will assess the extent of the injury and create a plan for recovery.
3. Rehabilitation: If a player has suffered an injury, the physiotherapist will work with the player to develop a rehabilitation plan to help them recover and get back to playing.
4. Performance enhancement: Physiotherapists work with players to develop strategies to improve their physical performance and reduce the risk of injury.
5. Education: Physiotherapists educate players on proper body mechanics, stretching techniques, and other methods to prevent injuries and maintain physical health.
### How Can Physiotherapy Tie into Esports?
Physiotherapy plays an important role in esports by helping players to stay healthy and perform at their best. It can also provide a competitive advantage for teams who invest in physiotherapy services.
Physiotherapy can also tie into esports in other ways. For example, a physiotherapist may work with esports organizations to develop ergonomic guidelines for players to prevent injuries. They may also work with equipment manufacturers to develop specialized chairs or other equipment that can help players maintain proper posture and reduce the risk of injury.
### Conclusion
In conclusion, physiotherapy plays a crucial role in the esports industry. Physiotherapists help players to prevent and recover from injuries, maintain physical health, and improve their performance. They also have the potential to provide a competitive advantage for teams who invest in physiotherapy services.

ABOUT FACTORY
Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.
We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.
In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).
ABOUT THE ROLE
Factory is looking for innovative Software Engineers to join our founding Federal team. You will build and evolve cutting-edge AI systems that transform how government software organizations accelerate their productivity and innovation. You will work directly with the Department of War, the Intelligence Community, and federal civilian agencies to bring Factory to secure, classified, and air-gapped environments, helping the nation's most critical software teams operate as autonomous software factories.
WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE
- Innovate at the forefront of AI by designing, developing, and deploying AI-driven agentic systems that enhance Factory's core AI capabilities for federal missions
- Deploy and harden the Factory Platform in secure government environments, including GovCloud, on-premises, classified, and fully air-gapped networks, so it runs with limited or no internet connectivity and with self-hosted or government-approved models
- Build security and compliance into everything you ship, partnering with Security and Infrastructure to achieve and maintain authorizations such as FedRAMP High and DoD Impact Levels (IL5/IL6), including access controls, audit logging, and continuous monitoring
- Build multi-layered guardrails, observability, and explainability into our agents so government users can trust, audit, and understand how an agent reached its output
- Engage directly with federal customers, on-site when needed, to understand their missions and workflows, define requirements with stakeholders, and own delivery from first prototype to accepted production deployment
- Integrate Factory with the tools government engineering teams already rely on, including on-premises source control, CI/CD pipelines, ticketing systems, and DoD software factories
- Work with product, engineering, and Federal go-to-market teams to integrate emerging AI research findings into practical, mission-focused solutions
- Engage in iterative development processes, rapidly prototyping and refining AI functionalities based on real-world feedback to meet the evolving needs of government developers and program offices
- Take the initiative in identifying and addressing product stability and scalability challenges, ensuring the Factory Platform reliably supports large-scale operational demands in high-consequence and resource-constrained environments
- Lead the exploration and integration of large-scale data processing techniques to improve the reliability and effectiveness of our AI systems
- Serve as the voice of the federal customer, bringing field insights back into Factory's core platform so that capabilities built for one mission become reusable across the public sector
- Help build our Federal team from the ground up, partnering with leadership on technical proposals, capture strategy, and the product roadmap for our public sector business

- Comfort working directly with customers, including time on-site at customer locations.
- A passion for public sector work and a belief in the potential of government institutions to deliver better outcomes through technology.
- Experience deploying software in regulated or secure environments (e.g., AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, FedRAMP, DoD Impact Levels, or classified and air-gapped networks) is highly desirable, though not mandatory.
- Familiarity with government work and its complexities, including procurement, compliance, and the accreditation (ATO) process, is a plus.
- Experience with data-intensive applications and familiarity with the software development lifecycle are highly desirable, though not mandatory.

Alongside credit, Fasanara also manages crypto market-neutral and multi-manager quantitative strategies, combining institutional investment discipline with proprietary technology and a global origination network.
Our Culture
We are strong believers in meritocracy, and we seek to reward people based on impact, judgement, and excellence in execution. We keep bureaucracy to a minimum, so decisions are made quickly and people have real ownership. Our environment is collaborative, inclusive, entrepreneurial, and built on trust. We set ambitious goals, work hard in a focused and sustainable way, and place a strong emphasis on teamwork, integrity, and quality in everything we do. We know we are only as good as our people, so we are deliberately building the firm around exceptional talent and diverse perspectives, and we support our leaders to grow, influence, and shape the future of the business.
The Role
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Graduate Accountant to join our Finance team. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience supporting the accounting and financial reporting of Fasanara’s global corporate entities.. Fasanara will support you towards an ACA or ACCA qualification, funding tuition, examination fees and professional subscriptions, and providing paid study and exam leave.
Working with experienced finance professionals, you will gain exposure to corporate financial reporting, month-end processes, reconciliations, statutory accounts, VAT and audit activities. Responsibilities will progressively increase as you develop technical accounting expertise and take ownership of key processes.
Responsibilities
Financial Reporting & Accounting
• Support month-end and year-end reporting, including journals, schedules and working papers.
• Assist with statutory accounts, disclosures and supporting documentation for corporate entities.
• Complete monthly reconciliations, investigate discrepancies and resolve outstanding items.
• Support intercompany reconciliations and accurate recording of group transactions. Tax, Audit & Compliance
• Assist with the preparation and reconciliation of VAT returns, learning applicable VAT rules.
• Support the year-end audit by preparing schedules and responding to information requests.
• Maintain accurate, audit-ready financial records and supporting documentation.
Finance Operations & Improvement
• Support accounts payable and receivable activities, including invoices and payment reconciliations.
• Help maintain accurate financial data across accounting systems.
• Identify opportunities to improve reporting and operational efficiency, including through AI tools and automation.
Professional Development
• Study towards an ACA or ACCA qualification, with tuition, examination fees, professional subscriptions and paid study and exam leave provided by Fasanara.
• Build knowledge of accounting principles, reporting standards and Finance processes.
• Gradually take ownership of recurring activities and collaborate with the wider business.
Requirements
Essential
• A 2:1 or above in a Finance or Accounting degree, or a Business degree with relevant accounting modules; alternatively, at least 6 months of relevant Finance or Accounting work experience.
• Basic understanding of accounting principles and terminology.
• Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organisational and communication skills.
• Attention to detail, initiative and willingness to learn.
• Commitment to studying towards an ACA or ACCA qualification.
Desirable
• Previous Finance or Accounting internship or work experience.
• Familiarity with accounting software or ERP systems.
• Experience with AI tools or an interest in automation.
• Interest in financial services or investment management.
What You’ll Gain
• ACA or ACCA qualification support, including tuition, examination fees, professional subscriptions and paid study and exam leave. The qualification typically takes around three years.
• Practical support and mentorship from experienced Finance professionals.
• Practical exposure to corporate financial reporting, accounting, tax, audit and Finance operations.
• Progressively greater ownership, mentorship and professional development.
• A permanent position from the outset, with long-term development opportunities within the Finance function.
Benefits
Our benefits include:
• Performance-related Bonus Scheme
• Private Medical & Dental Insurance through Bupa (including children's cover)
• Life Insurance, Income Protection & Critical Illness Cover
• Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) • Salary sacrifice pension with Hargreaves Lansdown (currently matched up to 10%)
• Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave
• Emergency Parental Leave, Emergency Childcare & Nursery Benefit
• Cycle to Work Scheme
• Charity Giving through CAF
• Annual Wellbeing Budget
• Team socials, annual Summer & Christmas parties, and other events throughout the year

Background to the role
A brand-new role in our Business Intelligence & Technology team, helping us make the most of AI across Faversham House.
Close mentoring from our technology lead, with full training and an apprenticeship for further development – we’re looking for aptitude and curiosity, not years of commercial experience.
A clear starting point in data research and enrichment, then wider development projects that align with our business goals.
Real variety: one day you’re improving how we enrich our data, the next you’re supporting our websites or testing a new workflow.
Person Specification
You'll need:
Regular, hands-on use of AI assistants such as Claude or ChatGPT, with a feel for their strengths and limits.
Basic programming (ideally Python or JavaScript) and the ability to read code you didn’t write.
Evidence of building something on your own initiative – a project, script, bot or website.
Sound judgement with data – you know why API keys, personal data and credentials need careful handling, and you ask before doing anything irreversible.
A structured approach to problem solving and clear communication, including explaining technical ideas to non-technical colleagues.
It would help if you also have:
A degree in a relevant subject such as Software Engineering, Data Engineering etc
Experience of using AI beyond everyday use, e.g. a custom GPT, Claude Project or automated task.
Some exposure to APIs, automation tools (Zapier, Power Automate) or SQL, and an interest in our sectors.
Why us?
Faversham House is an independent, award-winning B2B media and events company of 75+ people, based in a newly refurbished, collaboration-focused office in East Grinstead. We run two market-leading brands - Utility Week (utilities) edie (sustainability), reaching thousands of B2B professionals through digital publishing, events, conferences and awards. Our values aren't just words on a wall, we live them, every day: Ambitious: Be brave and achieve great things
Creative: Think differently and try something new
Caring: Love what you do and do what’s right
- 96% of our people are satisfied working here and we have a 91% staff retention rate
- We promote from within - 40% of our current team have been promoted at least once in the last three years.
- B Corp certified - our commitment to people and planet is independently verified, not just claimed.
- Genuine hybrid working - typically 2 days in our East Grinstead office, 3 from home, with flexibility around our core hours of 10am – 4pm
- Enhanced pension, private medical insurance and a medical cash plan.
- Enhanced maternity and paternity pay.
- 22 days plus bank holidays, rising to 27 days with service. You also get extra time off over Christmas and your birthday off
- A training budget for every employee - because we invest in growing your career, not just filling a seat.
- Wellbeing support - including a wellbeing scheme, Employee Assistance Programme and financial planning support.
- 2 paid volunteering days per annum to give back to a cause you care about
- Salary sacrifice scheme for home and technology purchases
At Faversham House, we believe great work comes from diverse perspectives. We encourage applications, regardless of age, disability, gender identity, relationship status, pregnancy/parental status, race, religion, or sexual orientation. Contact information
About us
Faversham House is a progressive, independent media group. Some even say small, but mighty.

job_title: Associate Director - Client Propositions, Investments & Product
job_description:
About the Opportunity
Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 16 November 2026
Title Associate Director - Client Propositions, Investments & Product
Department GPS Client Propositions
Location London
Reports To Head of GPS Client Propositions
Level 7
We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this?
By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
About your team
With a global presence across more than 25 locations around the world, Fidelity International provides investment services and retirement expertise to everyone from central banks and financial institutions to wealth managers
and private individuals. The goal of the Global Platform Solutions team is to build a profitable $500bn business by becoming the partner of choice for all an individual’s and family’s financial needs.
About your role
The purpose of the role is to support the commercial success of GPS by ensuring strategic priorities, investment decisions and change initiatives are aligned to client needs, business growth objectives and financial outcomes.
Business Performance & Growth
Co-ordinate the Client Strategic Roadmap Group (CSRG), ensuring discretionary investment and change activity is prioritised in line with business strategy, client outcomes and commercial objectives.
Own and evolve the 'ABC' prioritisation framework, providing clear criteria to support effective investment and resource allocation decisions.
Support the development and challenge of business cases across GPS, ensuring initiatives deliver tangible business value and strategic alignment.
Partner with Enterprise Change and Platform teams to align business planning, change delivery and resource allocation decisions.
Work closely with Finance to coordinate planning cycles, track delivery against financial objectives and measure outcomes.
Assess the commercial impact of strategic initiatives and identify opportunities to improve business performance, operational efficiency and client outcomes.
Client & Market Focus
Work as part of the Client Propositions Management team to ensure GPS delivers strong client outcomes while supporting the wider GPS business strategy.
Support strategic client-facing activities, including key client engagements and governance board interactions, providing insight and analysis that supports informed decision-making.
Partner with the Client Propositions Strategy team to translate strategic objectives into executable plans, measures and outcomes.
Ensure strategic roadmaps, priorities and investment decisions remain aligned to evolving client needs, market developments and business objectives.
Maintain awareness of client, industry and competitor trends to inform strategic planning and prioritisation decisions.
Decision Support
Create and operationalise a KPI and performance management framework across GPS, including goal-setting, performance measurement and reporting.
Establish effective planning and reporting routines at all levels of GPS, including reporting to the GPS Senior Leadership Team.
Provide inputs into Enterprise QSR, QVR and QPI activities, ensuring GPS priorities and performance are accurately represented.
Oversee the production of meaningful management information and performance reporting that measures delivery against strategic objectives and KPIs.
Provide insight, challenge and recommendations to senior stakeholders, supporting effective commercial decision-making and strategic investment choices.
Drive alignment of goals, objectives and outcomes across GPS through robust governance, reporting and performance management processes.
About You
We are seeking a commercially minded leader with the ability to combine strategic thinking, financial acumen and stakeholder influence to drive business outcomes.
Experience, Skills and Leadership Capabilities
Demonstrated ability to develop, evaluate and manage business cases, financial plans and resource allocation decisions.
Experience leading financial and business reporting activities, translating complex information into clear insights for senior stakeholders.
Strong understanding of the financial services industry, ideally within asset or wealth management.
Proven ability to communicate effectively, influence decision-making and build productive relationships across functions and levels of seniority.
Highly analytical, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends and make evidence-based recommendations.
Experience leading, developing and coaching team members, creating an environment that supports performance and career growth.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain high standards of quality and deliver results to agreed timescales.
Experience operating in a dynamic environment, adapting to changing priorities and contributing both strategically and operationally when required.
Commitment to continuous learning and developing broader knowledge of the asset and wealth management industry.
Feel rewarded
For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.
For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!
We are looking to hire an experienced full-life cycle Technical Recruiter to support the organization through its growth, predominantly within Engineering and Product with the opportunity to support other functions, like Marketing, Legal, and GBO. You'll be a driving force in building and executing the talent strategy, partnering with key stakeholders, and hiring top talent. This role will allow you to build positive relationships, exude our values, and contribute to our org-wide recruiting best practices and processes.  
In addition to execution on hiring, you will have the opportunity to support recruiting events, contribute to office expansion, and build strategic partnerships across the EMEA region.
This is a full time role that will be held in our London hub.
What you’ll do at Figma:
• Manage full-cycle recruiting processes for our technical organizations
• Partner with business leaders to develop top of funnel strategies for key roles
• Source and build healthy, representative pipelines to engage passive talent including: cold outreach, events, and content production while also effectively handling inbound applications and referrals
• Leverage data to inform your hiring strategy and articulate these insights to executives in order to influence and drive positive change
• Champion and spearhead various initiatives relating to belonging, equity and impact (BEI)
We'd love to hear from you if you have:
• 6+ years of full-cycle in house recruiting experience in a high growth business 
• Experience partnering with senior executives on Engineering, Tech & Product hiring
• Ability to build a talent strategy alongside your hiring managers, while delivering an exceptional candidate experience
• Excellent communication, in all formats and ability to adapt communication style based upon audience
• This role will focus on recruiting in EMEA
While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:
• In-house experience recruiting for a SaaS company
• Experience hiring leadership roles at the Director level, predominantly within Engineering or Product
• Expert knowledge of the SaaS/ scaling tech landscape and who our competitors in this space may be
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to accommodations-ext@figma.com. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities. 
Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to: 
• Holding interviews in an accessible location
• Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing
• Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers
• Changing the mode or format of interviews 
To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.
By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice.
Application limits: To help candidates focus on the opportunities most relevant to their skills and experience, Figma limits the number and frequency of applications. These limits apply to all roles:
• Candidates may submit up to 5 applications during any rolling 30-day period.
• Candidates may not reapply to the same role while an application is active or within 90 days of receiving a rejection.
Once the applicable days has passed, candidates are welcome to apply again.

About Finom
Finom is growing fast, and Finance needs data that grows with it. As our Lead Analytics Engineer for Finance, you'll be the data partner for treasury, reconciliation and accounting. You'll also support our corporate finance and investor reporting work together with the team's existing data partner. You'll build and scale the data model behind these areas, set standards, integrate the systems Finance relies on and bring in automation, including agents, where it saves real work
This isn't a "build what's in the ticket" role. You'll learn how Finance works and why, understand where the value is, and work with the team on how their processes run, proposing improvements and the data and tools to support them. You'll report to the Head of Central Data
What You Will Be Doing
- Partner with the Treasury, Reconciliation and Accounting teams on their processes, priorities and how data supports them.
- Build out treasury data: positions, cash flows and liquidity, as trusted data products the team can rely on day to day.
- Build and scale reconciliation, so that matching, breaks and exceptions are handled systematically rather than by hand.
- Support Accounting with the data, checks and integrations behind their close and day-to-day work.
- Support our corporate finance data partner on corporate finance and investor reporting, working from one shared model and set of definitions.
- Design and evolve the Finance data model, entities and metrics, with tests, lineage and documentation, so the team can reuse and extend them.
- Set data standards and quality checks for Finance data, and build integrations with the systems Finance uses.
- Bring automation and agents into Finance workflows where they remove recurring manual work.
- Look at how Finance processes run today, identify what can work better and connect each piece of data work to its business cost and value.
How We Work
You'll have high autonomy. You choose the tools and the approach, including trialling new vendors and open-source solutions. Sign-off is needed in two cases. The first is architecture: whether a solution scales, holds across use cases and growing volumes, and runs without constant support. The second is anything that feeds high-stakes decisions. Priorities are set by final business impact.
Who You Are
- You've worked in or closely with Finance: in a finance team, as a finance data partner, or in data work centred on treasury, reconciliation, accounting or FP&A.
- You understand how a finance function works: the close, cash and liquidity, reconciliations and the reports that come out of them.
- You write expert SQL and have strong dimensional or semantic data modelling skills.
- You've built metrics and data products that other teams depend on.
- You have ETL and data warehouse or lakehouse experience, including onboarding sources end to end.
- You choose precision over speed when the two conflict.
- You work like a consultant to the business: you understand how a process works, propose solutions and frame them in terms of business value.
Nice to Have
- Databricks and Unity Catalog
- Experience integrating ERP, accounting, banking or treasury systems
- Experience with workflow automation or agents in finance processes
- CI/CD, orchestration and infrastructure-as-code
- Background in fintech, banking or payments
How You'll Grow
In your first months you get to know Finance, the model, the stack and your stakeholders. By six months you're self-sufficient and make judgement calls on scope and design without escalating. From there, you set long-term goals together with your Finance stakeholders, own the data roadmap for treasury, reconciliation and accounting, and mentor others on analytics-engineering practice.
The Team
We're a small central team that works with every function, and Finance is our primary partner. We use a modern stack, you're free to try new tools, and there are incentives for driving change. AI assistants take on routine work so people can focus on harder problems. We work in English, think long term, and build data that functions keep developing after we deliver it

Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Manchester - 3 days on-site)
About Finova 
Finova is the UK's leading lending and savings technology provider, supporting one in every five mortgages nationwide. Our agile, cloud-native solutions enable over 60 banks, building societies, specialist lenders, equity release providers and a network of 2,400+ brokers to stay ahead in a competitive market.
Built on open architecture and backed by deep industry expertise, our platform is designed to scale. Each year, we process over £50 billion in loans, manage nearly £50 billion in savings, and support the digital servicing of more than 650,000 UK borrower accounts.
Be part of a team that’s driving innovation, enabling growth and shaping the future of UK lending.
For Lenders 
Finova offers a flexible, modular technology suite designed to help lenders move faster, scale efficiently and deliver standout digital experiences.
Financial Institutions use Finova to launch products faster, process applications up to 50% more efficiently and reduce operational costs — all while staying fully compliant in a fast-moving market. 
About the Role:
As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer based in Manchester, you will join a newly formed reliability engineering function with significant scope to shape foundational practices across the organisation. Working closely with core platform engineering and infrastructure teams, your primary purpose will be to treat reliability as an engineering discipline, systematically engineering out operational toil rather than absorbing manual workloads. You will take end-to-end ownership of critical reliability domains across an enterprise financial services platform that processes more than £50 billion in loans annually, driving resilience as our technology landscape modernises onto Google Cloud Platform.
About you:
• Proven track record in software engineering and tooling development, ideally featuring solid proficiency in C# and .NET, alongside automation scripting in PowerShell, Python, or Go.
• Substantial production experience running distributed architectures across Azure or AWS, with prior exposure to Google Cloud Platform regarded as a distinct advantage.
• In-depth expertise in modern observability frameworks, particularly OpenTelemetry, covering instrumentation design, telemetry pipelines, and targeted alerting strategies.
• Practical mastery of Site Reliability Engineering principles, including the implementation of Service Level Objectives (SLOs), error budgets, and systemic toil reduction.
• Demonstrated autonomy with the ability to investigate ambiguous reliability issues and deliver robust, scalable engineering solutions independently.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of influencing development teams to embed resilience directly into their software design cycles.
What will you be doing?
• Taking comprehensive ownership of observability, automated recovery, or workflow automation across major segments of Finova's financial platform.
• Identifying operational friction points and eliminating toil permanently through automated retries, self-healing architecture, and proactive fault detection.
• Partnering with engineering teams to establish meaningful SLOs and error budgets, using operational metrics to prioritise reliability investments.
• Participating in a compensated escalation rota, acting as incident commander for critical outages, and leading blameless post-incident reviews to ensure corrective actions are completed.
• Designing and executing comprehensive failover and disaster recovery verification programmes to uphold contractual client commitments.
• Raising engineering standards across the organisation through active mentorship, code reviews, and the creation of clear runbooks that empower support teams to resolve issues efficiently.
What We Offer:
• Hybrid working 🕰️
We operate on a hybrid model that is primarily office-based, requiring three days in the office each week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remainder.
• Private medical insurance 👩‍⚕️
Comprehensive health cover, with the option to add your family to your plan, because your well-being matters to us.
• Life assurance & income protection 💰
We provide life assurance and income protection to give you peace of mind for the future
• Family friendly policies 👶
Our enhanced family-friendly policy goes beyond maternity and paternity leave, offering paid time off for when plans change or alternative paths to parenthood are needed.
• Work from anywhere 🌴
Some thrive in the office, others at home — and many do best with choice. With approval, Finova employees can work abroad for up to 4 weeks each year.
• Flexible holiday package 🗓️
Enjoy 25 days paid holiday allowance, plus all public holidays. And, you can rebook any public holidays for a day that aligns with your personal beliefs or celebration calendar. We also offer holiday trading allowing you to purchase or sell your holiday allowance.
• Company pension scheme 🏦
With salary exchange, you save on tax and can build a secure future.
• Employee assistance programme 💞
We understand that mental health is just as important as physical health. Access to a 24/7 confidential counselling helpline ensures you have support when you need it.
• Electric car scheme 🚗
Get a brand-new electric vehicle with salary sacrifice as a benefit, paid for through your gross monthly pay, saving on Income Tax and National Insurance.
• Health cash plan 🏥
Our Health Cash Plan empowers you to prioritise your wellbeing by providing effortless reimbursement for everyday healthcare costs, from dental and optical visits to physiotherapy.
• Gym discounts 🏋️
Achieve your fitness goals for less with GymFlex, which offers significant savings on annual memberships at over 3,000 gyms and leisure centers nationwide.
• Perks that matter 🎁

Role purpose:
To provide consultant-level remote clinical input to support timely, safe management of ENT and audiology-related referrals and follow-ups. The post holder will triage referrals, deliver Advice and Guidance (A&G), complete diagnostic reviews (including scans), undertake harm reviews where required, and support delivery of contractual performance requirements (KPIs) while maintaining high standards of clinical governance.
Key responsibilities:
•Referral triage (e-RS / SystmOne): clinically triage incoming ENT referrals and associated clinical information to determine urgency, appropriate pathway, investigations required prior to appointment, and most suitable management plan.
•Advice and Guidance (A&G): provide timely, high-quality A&G responses to referring clinicians, including clear recommendations on investigations, interim treatment, red flags, safety-netting, and onward referral where indicated, in line with local pathways and national guidance.
•Contractual KPI delivery: support achievement of contract performance measures (for example response times) by prioritising work appropriately, tracking completion, and escalating capacity or pathway risks early.
•Diagnostic / scan reviews: review relevant investigation results (including imaging and diagnostic reports where provided), document an interpretation within scope, and make clear next-step recommendations (discharge, treatment plan, further investigation, or onward referral).
•Harm reviews: complete harm reviews for patients waiting within the service as required, identifying deterioration, safeguarding concerns, or clinical risk; document outcomes; and ensure appropriate action, escalation, and communication.
•Audiology follow-up: clinically review audiology outcomes and investigations, advise on next steps, and ensure appropriate follow-up plans (including discharge advice, patient-initiated follow-up where appropriate, or onward ENT review).
•Documentation: maintain accurate, timely clinical records on e-RS/SystmOne (or the agreed digital platform), including clear rationale for decisions, coding where required, and completion of mandatory fields needed for reporting and audit.
•Communication: communicate effectively and professionally with referrers, service managers and the wider MDT; provide clear written outputs suitable for sharing with patients/GPs where required.
•Clinical governance: comply with information governance, safeguarding, infection prevention (where relevant to remote work), incident reporting, and participate in audit/quality improvement as agreed.

We’re Hiring: Senior Finance Manager
The Senior Finance Manager will play a key leadership role within Glo-Bal’s group finance function, overseeing financial reporting, consolidation, budgeting, forecasting, cash management and financial control across a diverse portfolio of businesses.
Working closely with the Group CFO, senior leadership and finance leads, the role will provide accurate and meaningful financial information to support decision-making, business performance and sustainable growth.
The role will take ownership of portfolio reporting, strengthen financial controls and governance, provide commercial insight and support the integration of newly acquired businesses.
Key Responsibilities
Financial Reporting & Planning
- Lead the monthly reporting and consolidation process across the portfolio, ensuring accurate, timely and consistent financial information.
- Oversee management accounts and reporting packs for senior management and the Board.
- Analyse performance against budget and forecast, highlighting key trends, variances, risks and opportunities.
- Coordinate annual budgets, forecasts and longer-term financial plans.
- Maintain strong balance sheet control, including reconciliations, intercompany accounting and group recharges.
- Drive improvements in the quality and efficiency of financial reporting.
Cash, Treasury & Working Capital
- Oversee cash flow reporting and working capital management.
- Provide clear visibility of cash and funding requirements across the portfolio.
- Develop appropriate treasury processes and controls and manage group banking relationships.
- Monitor cash conversion, debtor performance and aged debt, working with businesses to improve cash generation.
Controls, Governance & Finance Systems
- Maintain and strengthen financial controls, accounting procedures and governance standards.
- Ensure consistent application of group finance policies and reporting requirements.
- Identify financial risks and control weaknesses and drive appropriate improvements.

About the Team Hiring
IT & Business Transformation is a global function reporting to the Graitec CEO, made up of four teams: Business
Transformation, Data & AI, Information Security, and IT Operations & Platforms. Together we own the delivery
capability behind how Graitec operates and we drive Graitec’s continued transformation.
We work as fusion teams and as one with the wider organisation: technology and business colleagues working
towards the same goals and outcomes.
Business Transformation is the delivery engine, turning Graitec's growth ambition into a sequenced, prioritised
portfolio delivered with precision and pace. It brings together programme delivery and the PMO, enterprise
architecture, change and adoption, and business partnering. The team is new, and this role builds and leads it.
Overview
Business Purpose & Value Contribution
This role leads Graitec's transformation portfolio: the programmes that change how we sell, deliver, bill and serve
our customers, and the governance, architecture and change capability that make them land.
Graitec's plan is for revenue to grow faster than headcount, driven by platforms and process rather than people,
as we move further towards integrated solutions, our own software and recurring services. The role brings our
change into one coherent portfolio, from ERP modernisation and the commercial growth engine to customer self-
service, services at scale and corporate AI. Success is measured in value captured and adopted, not in systems
deployed.
You will build and lead a team of programme and project managers, a PMO and enterprise architecture, and be
the senior transformation partner to Graitec's leadership team, working with the SVP IT & Business
Transformation. This is an opportunity to shape how a growing, acquisitive software and services business works.
It is not a traditional PMO or an advisory role: it is hands-on leadership, accountable for outcomes and credible
with executives and delivery teams alike.
Key Outcomes Expected
What success looks like in the first 12 months
· A single, prioritised transformation portfolio agreed with the leadership team, with a baselined business
case and a named business owner for every initiative
· Portfolio governance live across all programmes: one intake route, stage gates, and trusted executive
reporting on progress, cost and benefits
· Major programmes, including the Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations rollout, delivered within 10% of
baseline time and cost
· Benefits tracked for every initiative from baseline, with realised value reported to the board and investors
in EBITDA and revenue terms
· A target enterprise architecture and business capability model published, with integration and master data
standards that every programme builds to
· Change and adoption built into every delivery, with business readiness confirmed before go-live and
adoption measured after
· A repeatable acquisition integration playbook in place, so new businesses join common processes and
platforms at pace
· A strong, engaged Business Transformation team in place, with fusion teams and the business working to
shared outcomes and measures
Responsibilities
Strategy and Leadership
· Own Graitec's transformation roadmap, tied to the value creation plan and sequenced with the business
plan and the investment cycle
· Lead, coach and grow a distributed team of programme and project managers, PMO and enterprise
architecture across Europe and North America
· Act as senior transformation partner to the leadership team, turning strategic priorities into a funded,
sequenced portfolio
· Own the team's operating model and budget, and Graitec's frameworks, standards and practices for delivering change.
Portfolio Governance & Value · Run portfolio governance end to end, with no more process than it needs: intake, prioritisation, stage gates, dependencies, resourcing and executive reporting
· Build investment cases with the business for each major initiative, stating cost, benefits, risk and payback
· Own benefits realisation: baselines before build, named benefit owners, and reporting of realised value, stopping what does not pay back
· Bring objective, data-led challenge to proposals and progress, and escalate early when a decision is needed
Programme Delivery · Be accountable for delivery across the portfolio: ERP and enterprise platforms, Customer and Revenue, Data and AI, and IT and Security
· Hold programmes to scope, quality, time and cost, resolving barriers and making trade-offs visible to sponsors
· Build repeatable deployment playbooks so each country rollout lands faster than the last
· Manage implementation partners and systems integrators to plan, cost and outcomes
Process, Change & Adoption · Build Graitec's change and adoption capability, with business readiness, training and communication part of every delivery
· Establish end-to-end process ownership with the business for core value streams, including quote to cash and project delivery to invoice, with controls designed in from the start
· Design standard end-to-end processes with the business, creating them where none exist
· Redesign processes before automating them, then apply automation and AI with Data & AI where the flows and data are ready
· Hand over to business owners once processes, controls and measures are working, so adoption and results stay owned by the business
Business Partnering · Build business partnering with each function, forming fusion teams with shared KPIs and OKRs
· Work in close partnership with Data & AI, IT Operations & Platforms and Information Security so change lands cleanly into run, with data and security designed in
Enterprise Architecture
· Own the enterprise architecture: business capability model, value streams, target architecture, and the roadmap to fewer, integrated platforms
· Run a design authority so every programme builds towards the target architecture
· Own the acquisition integration playbook for processes, data and platforms, with IT Operations & Platforms delivering the core IT integration
Responsibilities
Skills & Experience
· 12+ years in business transformation, consulting or programme leadership, including at least five in-
house in an international business, leading a multi-programme portfolio with team and budget
accountability
· Personal leadership of at least one major ERP or CRM go-live through to adoption and measured benefits, ideally on Microsoft Dynamics 365
· Portfolio management and benefits realisation at executive level, with investment cases that stand up to CFO scrutiny
· Has set up a PMO or transformation office, including portfolio governance, methods and tooling
· Enterprise or business architecture: capability models, value streams, target architectures, and integration and master data design
· Process redesign across end-to-end value streams such as quote to cash, ideally in B2B software, subscription or professional services
· Leadership of organisational change across multinational, multicultural teams, closing the gap between go-live and real adoption
· Strong partner and vendor management, holding systems integrators to scope, quality, time and cost
· Executive presence and commercial acumen: credible with the leadership team, willing to make hard prioritisation calls, and able to lead through influence without line authority
· Fluency with AI and automation in business processes, and a pragmatic view of where they pay back
· Hands-on, able to build a new team and new ways of working while delivering
Also valued
· Experience in a growing, acquisitive or private equity-backed business, including post-acquisition integration
· A consulting background, or experience building a transformation office from the ground up
· TOGAF, MSP, PgMP, PMP, Prosci, Lean Six Sigma or equivalent qualifications
· Software or SaaS sector experience, including recurring revenue and renewals

Project description
JUXT is partnering with a Tier 1 investment bank (Citibank) to modernise the frontend estate within an area of capital markets. The trading desks rely on a mix of legacy thick-client and Angular 4 / AngularJS tooling that are being progressively consolidated and replaced with modern, high-performance React apps.
You will be embedded in a high-performing engineering team working on production trading surfaces used by traders across the world. The work is technically demanding: low-latency UIs over realtime feeds, large streaming grids, custom binary protocols, and a focus on quality, stability and performance.
Tech stack: React, TypeScript, ag-grid, WebSockets, RSocket, Solace, Simple Binary Encoding (SBE), Java services, OpenShift, Tekton pipelines.
Client description
Citibank is a Tier 1 investment bank, and one of the world’s largest. This role is in Citibank’s FX eTrading UI team (FX Fusion / Low Latency). Working on modernising legacy Angular 4 / AngularJS trading applications to a modern React stack, delivering high-performance, low-latency UIs for FX trading desks.
Location: London, Canary Wharf. Hybrid working, 3 days per week in the office alongside traders and the engineering team.
Essential functions
• Building new React applications for pricing, execution and post-trade analytics, deployed both as standalone web apps and inside the bank’s container-based environment.
• - Wiring UIs directly to real-time messaging infrastructure and working with binary message formats, to minimise latency.
• - Working with large, fast-moving data sets in the browser (ag-grid blotters, streaming pricing tiles, depth views) where rendering performance and memory behaviour matter.
• - Contributing to shared component libraries, app templates and standards so new apps have a consistent foundation.
• - Migrating legacy Angular 4 / AngularJS applications onto a modern React stack.
• - Building automated UI tests, to reduce reliance on manual QA.
• - Owning deployment via the bank’s CI/CD into containerised production environments.
Qualifications
Essential:
• Strong React and TypeScript engineer with a track record of shipping production frontends and experience of AG Grid - ideally in trading, market data, or another low-latency, high-throughput domain.
• - Deep understanding of browser performance: rendering pipelines, virtualisation, memory pressure, profiling, and what it takes to keep a streaming UI responsive under load.
• - Comfortable consuming realtime feeds in the browser (WebSocket, RSocket, or pub/sub messaging) and reasoning about backpressure, reconnection, snapshots and recovery.
• - Pragmatic full-stack instincts - you can read and reason about the Java service feeding your UI even if you do not write it day to day.
• - Strong testing discipline and experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar.
Highly valued but not essential:
• Experience migrating Angular or AngularJS applications to React.
• - Direct experience with Solace or comparable messaging infrastructure (Tibco EMS, Kafka in low-latency configurations, Aeron).
• - Familiarity with binary wire formats - Simple Binary Encoding (SBE), FlatBuffers, Protobuf - and an appetite for pushing decoding into the browser.
• - Exposure to ag-grid or equivalent enterprise data-grid libraries at scale.
• - FX domain knowledge - spot, forwards, options, pricing, market-making, TCA - or a strong appetite to learn.
• - Experience with single-dealer platforms, RFQ / RFS workflows or order management UIs.
• - Container-based deployment.
We offer
• Opportunity to work on bleeding-edge projects
• Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team
• Competitive salary
• Flexible schedule
• Benefits package - medical insurance, sports
• Corporate social events
• Professional development opportunities
• Well-equipped office

ABOUT GRIFFIN
Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.
We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.
We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.
Learn more about what we do https://griffin.com
OUR CULTURE
We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.
We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.
We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.
Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.
Learn more about our culture. https://griffin.com/culture
THE COMMERCIAL TEAM
We strive to bring the best in technology, user experience and banking to the embedded finance space and be the bank for fintechs and corporates to build on.
As the third hire in the Customer Success team, you'll help customers maximise value from our product and drive growth opportunities.
WHO ARE YOU
The ideal candidate for this job will have most of the following:
- 2-3 years experience in B2B customer success, account management or a related role, ideally in financial services, banking or fintech
- Excellent problem-solving and project management abilities, with experience managing competing priorities while consistently delivering results
- Demonstrated success in customer retention and driving account expansion
- Strong relationship-building skills with experience developing trust and rapport across external and internal stakeholders
We’re hybrid-remote, and most of your colleagues will not share an office with you on a day-to-day basis. This means you should also have:
- A high degree of comfort adopting new software tools for document drafting, collaboration and communication.
- A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write https://griffin.sh/how-we-write )
WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING HERE?
As a Customer Success Manager at Griffin, you will
- Build strong relationships with your customer portfolio through regular touch-points and QBRs
- Collaborate with our implementation and technical teams to ensure smooth implementation and faster time-to-value
- Identify revenue expansion opportunities Uncover upselling and cross-selling potential within existing accounts
- Contribute and improve existing processes to optimise the customer experience
- Be an advocate for customers internally, respond to issues and share product feedback
WHAT CAN WE OFFER YOU?
We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.
- Salary: £50,000 DOE + commission
- 25 days off a year + winter break(we close in between Christmas and New Year) + bank holidays
- Share options - so you own a piece of what we’re building
- Remote-first flexibility - work from anywhere in the UK
- Support with home office setup
- 1:1 coaching and therapy through Oliva
- Auto-enrolment into company pension scheme with Penfold
- Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months at full pay
- Private medical insurance and life insurance (provided by Bupa and AIG respectively)
As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks
HOW DO I APPLY?
Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.
WE’RE REMOTE-FIRST
We trust people to do great work wherever they are. We hire across the UK and most of our team works remotely full-time. We have a small London office in Moorgate for those who want it, and about a third of the company is close enough to use it occasionally, but there's no expectation to be there. What matters is the work, not where you do it.
UNDER REPRESENTATION
At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

About The Role
The Senior Financial Accountant is responsible for the integrity, accuracy and timely delivery of the Group’s external, investor and statutory reporting. This is a hands-on, standalone role with end-to-end ownership of the annual report and financial statements, from underlying accounting and consolidation through to narrative and financial disclosures. Reporting to the Financial Controller, the role works in close partnership with the Head of Financial Accounting and their team, as well as senior stakeholders, advisers and external auditors.About You
Key responsibilities
External, statutory and investor reporting
· Own the end-to-end production of the Group annual report and consolidated financial statements, covering both the front-end narrative and back-end financial statements, notes and disclosures.
· Lead the preparation of statutory accounts for the Group and its legal entities, ensuring compliance with applicable accounting standards, company law, regulatory requirements and filing deadlines.
· Manage Group consolidation and reporting across all entities, including validation of submissions, consolidation adjustments, eliminations and disclosure information.
· Own investor and other external financial reporting deliverables, ensuring information is accurate, consistent, appropriately controlled and clearly communicated.
· Lead the accounting and reporting for tax, working with internal stakeholders and external advisers to ensure appropriate current and deferred tax treatment and disclosures.
· Coordinate finance inputs into ESG and sustainability reporting, maintaining a clear audit trail and supporting the development of robust reporting controls.
· Own covenant reporting, including calculation, review, supporting documentation and timely submission to relevant stakeholders.
Audit and technical accounting
· Act as the principal finance contact for external auditors on all financial reporting matters.
· In close collaboration with the Head of Financial Accounting, plan and coordinate the reporting elements of statutory audit processes, agreeing deliverables, maintaining schedules and driving timely resolution of queries.
· Prepare and review audit support, technical accounting papers and evidence for significant judgements, estimates and disclosures.
· Track audit findings relating to reporting and ensure agreed actions are implemented and embedded.
Month-end close and accounting ownership
· Own month-end accounting for non-trading and holding companies, ensuring complete, accurate and timely results.
· Manage intercompany accounting, reconciliation and elimination across the Group, resolving differences promptly with the relevant finance teams.
· Lead the management accounting consolidation and delivery of consolidated month-end reporting in line with the agreed timetable.
· Maintain high-quality balance sheet reconciliations and ensure appropriate review and control over journals, adjustments and consolidation entries.
· Partner closely with the Head of Financial Accounting and their team to align entity-level accounting with Group reporting requirements and deliver an efficient close.
· Own the reconciliation of management accounts to statutory accounts.
Financial systems, data and controls
· Own and govern the Group chart of accounts, ensuring consistent design, mapping, use and documentation across entities and reporting outputs.
· Act as finance lead and subject-matter expert for the Tagetik consolidation and reporting system, including process design, data integrity, controls, issue resolution and continuous improvement.
· Lead the effective use and development of Accurri statutory accounts software and Xero for relevant entities and reporting processes.
· Maintain clear process documentation, reporting timetables and controls across all areas of responsibility.
· Identify and implement improvements to reporting, consolidation and close processes, balancing technical rigour with efficiency and scalability.

• Manage study execution, including timelines, budgets, quality control, and vendor coordination.
• Develop and review analytic code ensuring reproducibility and quality using programming tools such as R or SAS.
• Communicate results clearly to internal teams and external audiences, supporting publications and payer dossiers.
• Mentor junior biostatisticians and contribute to best practices across evidence generation teams.

• Master’s degree or PhD in biostatistics, epidemiology, statistics, data science, or related quantitative field.

GSK’s Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. The Director, Forward Deployed Engineering leads the FDE function for the research engine of the Chemical Manufacturing Controls (CMC) and will drive the front of the Enterprise AI delivery pipeline that proves AI ideas with the business through first production versions, before handing proven solutions off to the Solutions Engineer for scale-up. The pattern is proven by AI-native companies — Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI — and this role brings that model to GSK.
This Staff role leads the Forward Deployed Engineering function with direct line management of the FDE team. The Staff sets FDE strategy and engagement priorities, owns Director-level BU sponsor relationships, and represents Enterprise AI on FDE matters to GSK leadership. The role continues to contribute technically at the frontier of AI-augmented engineering — humans steer, agents execute.
CMC is the GSK function that turns a validated molecule into a reliably manufactured, quality-assured medicine; its mission is to get safe, effective, consistently manufactured medicines to patients, faster. To support GSK's ambition to double new product introductions, the CMC Acceleration program is composed of three engines: the Development Engine, which fosters molecule and process development (R&D); the Tech Transfer Engine, which expedites the path from R&D to market (GSC); and the Data & Automation Engine (across CMC), which provides the foundational knowledge system and agentification of the full CMC process.
This role will build and scale the digital twin, physical AI, and self-driving lab capability that connects virtual process models to real-world process signals and closed-loop experimentation, underpinning real-time process modeling and accelerated process development for drug substance and drug product manufacturing. You bring deep, hands-on AI/engineering expertise and the judgement to turn ambiguous CMC R&D problems into shipped, production-grade systems, while mentoring the engineers around you.

Enterprise AI’s ability to build credibility with the business depends on engineers who can land inside BU problems, prove value quickly, and hand off cleanly. The Director, Forward Deployed Engineering builds and leads the function that makes this happen.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Governance & Reporting

• Demonstrated experience taking AI ideas from sketch to working software at speed, in customer-facing engineering roles.

It uniquely integrates clinical pharmacology, digital medicine, translational imaging, and mechanistic & systems modeling.
The convergence of science and technology is changing discovery and development at GSK, allowing us to make advances on behalf of patients that were once thought impossible. Our R&D organization is delivering more innovation, better and faster, using new data and platform technologies that speed up discovery and development and improve the chance of success.
This position represents a key opportunity for professionals with PhD, MD, or PharmD, who are experienced mechanistic modelers with experience in QSP and/or QST modeling, clinical pharmacology and pharmacometrics, to join the Quantitative Systems Pharmacology team to advance the vision and mission of GSK’s rapidly expanding Respiratory, Inflammation and Immunology Disease portfolio.
Sought after experiences for this position include building mechanistic mathematical models and leveraging knowledge in the areas of scientific ML, inverse problems, AIML and/or statistical methodologies, to enhance the robustness and quality of model development to leverage for decision-making from exploratory research through clinical development. You will be expected to play a critical role in the day-to-day driving integration of end-to-end model-informed drug discovery and development through building and applying mechanistic QSP and QST models. This is an exciting opportunity to bring your vision and leadership to a new era of digital innovation in clinical pharmacology and quantitative medicine, profoundly impacting patient outcomes and shaping the future of R&D at GSK.

· Develop and/or utilize state-of-the-art mathematical tools including knowledge of inverse-problem modelling and simulation, scientific ML and/or statistical techniques to gain insight into causal relationships between individual components of system-level and drug-level responses of drug-target-biomarker-disease-patient interaction
· Define and execute a coordinated scientific and technical strategy (3-24 months planning horizon) with demonstrated ability to co-ordinate outputs from several expertise areas to determine strategy · Work in close collaboration with biologists, clinicians, clinical pharmacologists, pharmacometricians, statisticians, AIML, imaging, biomarker and other partner line colleagues to inform research and development programs and improve our understanding of disease mechanisms · Implement best practices, trends, lessons learned from internal and external sources to further clinical pharmacology modelling and simulation contributions to R&D pipeline · Create a collaboration framework with internal and external experts in the development and application of these models · Learn and apply emerging modeling and simulation methodologies with a view to enhance clinical program efficiency and investment decision quality; collaborate with external field- leading teams for methodology application · Able to efficiently and effectively interact with line and middle management, staff and external contacts on a functional, strategic and tactical level · Represent QSP CPQM on various internal advisory boards, companywide initiatives and/or leadership teams · Promote transparency and communicate R&D achievements through publications in appropriate scientific journals Why you? · PhD, MD, or PharmD with experience in mechanistic modelling and simulation and systems biology with applications in pharmaceutical research and development · Minimum 7 years of experience in mechanistic mathematical modeling, inverse problem modeling and simulation, and/or scientific machine learning methodologies to be applied to pre-clinical and/or clinical questions in drug development to solve practical problems in the pharmaceutical industry · Experience working with senior stakeholders in a cross functional environment · Track record of implementation of Model-Informed Drug Discovery and Development (MIDD) approaches to accelerate patient access to novel therapies and to expand therapeutic indications of marketed drugs
Preferred Qualifications:
· Strong drive and agility to quickly learn and build knowledge on a drug-disease system, the mechanism, endpoints, progression, prevention, treatments, and trial design
· Demonstrated aptitude for productive collaboration in a multi-discipline team, using effective communication and taking personal accountability for timely delivery of results · Clear evidence / experience in making sound judgement in complex situations and adapting to changing business needs by prioritizing multiple tasks · Prior experience in Hepatology, Respiratory and/or Cardiometabolic diseases is a plus

Join the GSK’s R&D Global Clinical Study Delivery Graduate Programme – UK 2027: Help us get ahead of disease together
Education required: BSc degree from an accredited college/university, preferably in medical or biological science or discipline associated with clinical studies (for example life sciences or pharmacy). Graduation by August 2027.
Language requirement: Written and spoken fluency in English
Other requirements: Willingness to be geographically mobile (domestic) throughout rotations
Location: GSK HQ London
Expected Start date: September 2027
Application deadline: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and this role will close once we have received enough applications. We recommend you apply as soon as possible.
Assessment Centre Date: January/February 2027.
Are you a talented and driven student or graduate eager to make an impact on billions of lives? Apply for the Global Clinical Study Delivery program at GSK today! GSK is a global biopharma company with a special purpose – to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Getting ahead means preventing disease as well as treating it, and we aim to impact the health of 2.5 billion people around the world in the next 10 years. Our success absolutely depends on our people. We want GSK to be a place where people feel inspired, encouraged, and challenged to be the best they can be. A place where they can be themselves – feeling welcome, valued and included. Where they can keep growing and look after their wellbeing. So, if you share our ambitions, join us at this exciting moment in our journey to get ahead together. With over 300 years of innovation, we’re a science-led global healthcare company that discovers, develops and manufactures innovative medicines and vaccines. Join us and help millions of people do more, feel better, live longer. Are you ready to use your skills to deliver high-quality clinical trials? If so, you could be suited to this role! Together we can design, plan and deliver clinical trials across a range of therapeutic areas, delivering medicines and vaccines to our patients. Ahead together with tailored training and career development We’ll tailor your training and development to suit your talents and ambition, as well as our business needs, setting you up for success in your chosen niche. The skills you learn on our Graduate programme can be used across many areas of our business and, potentially, many countries. There’s no limit to how far you can go with us – it’s up to you to prove yourself. Over the next two years, the Graduate Programme will challenge and support you to grow both professionally and personally. job_title: Head of Data and Data Science, R&D, ED&AI
job_description:
Business Introduction
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centered on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
Position Summary
Are you a seasoned data and data science leader ready to shape how trusted data, advanced analytics, and agentic AI accelerate R&D decisions?
Join GSK’s Enterprise Data & AI organization as Director of Data & Data Science, Development Data. You will own the strategy, organization, and delivery of data and data science capabilities across R&D, including a portfolio of R&D Data Categories led by Senior Technical Data Product Owners.
In this highly visible leadership role, you will set portfolio strategy, guide people and investment decisions, establish consistent governance and delivery standards, and represent the function with senior R&D and Enterprise Data & AI leaders. You will also remain close to the technology and science: at least 50% of your time will be hands-on—writing code, building and evaluating models, and developing agentic AI systems that perform trusted data-science work with appropriate human oversight.
Your responsibilities
This is an opportunity to build a high-impact function at the intersection of data, science, and AI. Your key responsibilities will include:

We manufacture and supply reliable, high-quality medicines and vaccines to meet patients’ needs and drive our performance.
Our network of 37 medicines and vaccines manufacturing sites delivered 1.7 billion packs of medicines and 409 million vaccine doses in 2024 to help make a positive impact on the health of millions of people.
