So, with that in mind, we’ve tried to keep our description simple and cliché-free to help you decide if PerchPeek and this role are a good match for you.
About PerchPeek
At PerchPeek we dream of a borderless world where people have the freedom to live and work where they please. Where ideas and resources flow where they’re most needed unrestricted by national borders. We strive to create a world of opportunity for anyone, anywhere – one move at a time.
We’re building a streamlined Mobility ecosystem to empower businesses and individuals to move anywhere in the world. We support employers and employees through every stage of the relocation process, providing an affordable, scalable, high-value service, powered by technology and relocation expertise.
Have you ever relocated? If so, you probably know how overwhelming it can be—immigration hoops, tax implications, housing, shipping, utilities, banking…the list goes on. No matter where in the world you go, relocating is complicated, time-intensive, and stressful. PerchPeek was conceived to change that.
For relocators employees, our goal is to guide them through every step of their move with a delightful mix of tech, coaching, content, and partnerships which work together to make relocating simpler, faster, and more fun. For employers, we streamline the entire process of supporting international Mobility into one easy-to-use platform, turning Mobility into a strategic advantage for thriving globally.
Now you know why we’re so passionate about what we do!
About the role
The Senior Account Executive will win new business across the UK and Europe, focusing on fast-growing tech and AI scale-ups alongside larger enterprise mobility deals. You’ll build most of your own pipeline and own the full sales cycle, with a target of 1–2 new pilots per month once ramped, converting successful pilots into full rollouts. A successful candidate is a consistently high-performing, autonomous seller with a track record of generating pipeline and closing complex deals, who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to help shape the future of go-to-market at PerchPeek!
Role Responsibilities
Whilst every role in a startup has a degree of flexibility over time, here is what we see as the role’s main responsibilities:
• Land new logos through pilots - Take fast-growing European scale-ups & enterprises from first conversation to a signed pilot, then convert that pilot into a full rollout.
• Target clients - Fast-growing tech and AI scale-ups in the UK and Europe (roughly 500 to 5,000 employees). We already work with many of Europe’s fastest growing organisations and are targeting the rest. Once ramped, expect to land 1 to 2 new pilots per month.
• Enterprise Mobility deals – About a quarter of the role is larger, mobility-led enterprise deals that come from industry events, often through RFPs and longer sales processes.
• Build your own pipeline - You'll generate most of your pipeline through network, referrals, founders and VCs, trigger-based outbound and events.
• Playbook input - We're still relatively early in our GTM journey and we'll be counting on you to shape how we win here and pave the way for future AEs.
• Build the PerchPeek Network – Develop and grow relationships with others in the Mobility industry; be a PerchPeek evangelist and represent PerchPeek at events (online/offline, owned and externally organized).
About You
The type of person we think will be awesome in this role will likely have a track record of the below skills and experience:
• A track record of being a consistently top performing AE - ranked in top 1 or 2 of their team
• Experience running a pilot or proof-of-concept and converting it into a full contract
• Built their own pipeline: a large share of past closed revenue was self-sourced
• Experience running full sales cycles with multiple stakeholders
• Comfortable with fast change and light structure; we value autonomous learning and think the best fit for this role is someone who doesn't need daily coaching
• Willing (and able!) to Travel throughout Europe – we are a fully remote company, which means you’ll predominantly be able to work wherever you’d like. However, you should expect to travel throughout the year for this role, whether that’s for client meetings, conferences, networking functions or staff events.
While not necessary, we’re especially interested in candidates with the below:
• Experience selling into HR or People teams at scale-ups
• Experience selling a usage-based or consumption product
• Experience with consultative selling / managed services
• Experience running RFP-led enterprise deals through procurement
• Experience using MEDDPICC framework
• An existing network in the European tech and scale-up scene
• A second language relevant to our markets (e.g. German, Dutch, Nordic)
Pay & Benefits
Salary
PerchPeek values transparency in our approach to global compensation. We aim to be holistic, fair, and always improving. We are data-led and regularly evaluate our salary ranges against other companies of a similar size and stage. Total compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to demonstrated skill set, years and depth of relevant experience, and location. In your first interview, we’ll have an open conversation about compensation.
The PerchPerks
• Company share options - be a business owner and have your very own little piece of PerchPeek. • Flexible Holiday and Leave - you’ll receive all statutory holiday plus wellbeing leave and flexible annual leave for you to rest, relax, or recharge as you see fit.
• Work from Anywhere - PerchPeek is a fully distributed company that supports employees in working wherever they’d like to be within the parameters of your role’s requirements. We offer an allowance to ensure your working environment suits you.
• Learning & Development Budget - so you can be proactive about learning something fun outside of your core role
• Regular socials, an annual offsite, and a meetups budget - or time spent turning colleagues into friends (corny but we don’t care).
Ready to be a Perchy?
Firstly, no need for a full cover letter (phew)! Please just share your resume and respond to the application questions. If we seem well-matched, you’ll be invited for an initial screening with one of the PerchPeek team where we’ll align on timeline, compensation, and get to know each other a bit better!
Then, we'll run an interview process with different members of our team: • Stages 1 and 2 will deep-dive on skills, experience, and culture alignment. • Stage 3 will include a “take-home” task and a final roundtable interview. All interviews will take place via video call. We aim to respond to all applications within 3 weeks.
We hope you’re as excited to apply as we are to hear from you!

We’re looking for a measurement leader to show brands the impact of advertising on our app. You’ll build a clear, credible approach to measuring campaign performance across our inventory, turn results into useful recommendations, and help our commercial team demonstrate the value of partnering with us.
You’ll work across Sales, Ad Operations, Product, Data and external research partners. The role combines hands-on campaign analysis with building the measurement products and processes that can scale as the business grows.
What you’ll do
• Define the measurement strategy for brand campaigns across our app and any associated channels.
• Establish practical measurement frameworks for reach, frequency, engagement, brand lift and other relevant outcomes.
• Lead campaign studies, including survey-based brand lift, conversion measurement and advertiser-specific research where appropriate.
• Translate campaign and audience data into clear reporting, case studies and recommendations for brands.
• Build repeatable measurement packages that the sales team can explain and sell.
• Partner with Ad Operations and Product to improve campaign tagging, data quality, reporting and measurement readiness.
• Work with Data and Analytics teams to develop dashboards and reliable ways to assess campaign performance.
• Manage relationships with research vendors, measurement platforms and other external partners.
• Set standards for study design, methodology, privacy and responsible use of data.
• Train and support commercial teams so they can confidently discuss measurement with clients.
• Track market developments and bring forward new approaches that improve the value of our advertising offer.
What you’ll bring
• Experience in advertising measurement, media research, marketing science, analytics or a related field.
• A track record of measuring campaigns for publishers, platforms, agencies or brands.
• Familiarity with brand lift studies, survey research, attribution and campaign effectiveness methods.
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to explain findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
• Experience turning measurement into commercial tools, client recommendations or sales enablement.
• Confidence working across Sales, Product, Data and Operations teams.
• Good judgement around research quality, privacy and the limits of what campaign data can show.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including presenting results to senior clients.
What success looks like
• Brands understand what our campaigns delivered and what they learned.
• Measurement is included in more proposals and is straightforward to activate.
• Campaign reporting is timely, consistent and trusted by clients.
• Insights lead to useful recommendations, repeat investment and stronger case studies.
• Our measurement offer grows without compromising research quality or user privacy.

job_description:
About us
Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence
PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace & defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy & renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.
The role
You will build the LLM access layer for agents on the PhysicsX platform. That layer serves self-hosted open models and routes each task to the model, or combination of models, that best fits its constraints.
We want to bring deep, production experience in self-hosted LLM serving and model routing into PhysicsX. You will establish the capability to run open models reliably and choose between self-hosted and external models according to the needs of each workload. You will set the technical direction for inference engines such as vLLM and SGLang, and serving platforms such as KServe. You will build foundations that product, delivery and customer teams can rely on.
You will own both. You will learn our requirements and define the implementation, rather than inherit a prescribed gateway design. You will wire serving and routing into the existing platform, identity and observability systems.
In the near term, you’ll make the platform’s agentic capabilities work out of the box, with no customer-supplied API key needed. Longer term, you’ll build the serving layer into a flexible routing foundation that balances competing priorities, such as cost, quality and data sensitivity, as our needs change.
What you will do
• Make self-hosted serving and model routing work in air-gapped deployments, including sites where the hardware, connectivity and operational setup force constrained solutions.
• Own LLM packaging, registration, deployment, health checks, upgrades, rollback and retirement for supported LLMs.
• Evaluate and integrate serving platforms such as KServe, including inference services, serving runtimes, model loading and rollout controls.
• Define, model, and implement service levels for availability, quality, and performance metrics (e.g. time to first token, inter-token latency, and tail latency).
• Measure and improve throughput, GPU utilisation, memory use and cost per token under representative agent workloads.
• Tune continuous and chunked batching, KV and prefix caching, quantisation, speculative decoding and tensor, data or expert parallelism where appropriate.
• Evaluate advanced techniques such as cache-aware routing and prefill/decode disaggregation when workload evidence justifies their complexity.
• Build autoscaling, admission control and capacity management around GPU and serving signals rather than generic CPU metrics.
• Make every routing decision observable and explainable, and use evaluation evidence before adding specialist routes.
• Work with Research and Post-Training specialists to move candidate and tuned models through evaluation into supported production routes.
• Help determine how this capability should grow and, over time, shape the team around it.
What you bring
Where you need to be strongest
• You have operated inference engines such as vLLM or SGLang, or serving platforms such as KServe, under production traffic, latency and reliability constraints.
• You can explain the boundary between serving orchestration and inference execution, including how deployment, scaling and runtime configuration affect performance.
• You have built or operated model routing across more than one provider, and can explain how you balanced cost, quality, latency, failure and policy.
• You can describe the serving architecture you operated, the bottlenecks you found, the changes you made and the measured effect on latency, throughput, reliability or cost.
• You understand LLM inference as a systems problem: batching, scheduling, KV-cache behaviour, memory pressure, model parallelism and GPU utilisation.
• You have built and operated GPU workloads on Kubernetes, including deployment, scaling, observability and failure recovery.
• You can turn fast-moving open-source engines and provider APIs into a supportable product with versioning, compatibility testing, rollback and clear operational boundaries.
• You are a strong systems engineer who remains hands-on in architecture, implementation, profiling and production debugging.
• Your experience goes materially beyond local model runners or demonstrations; tools such as Ollama are not a substitute for production serving ownership.
Foundations
• Strong Python plus a systems language such as Go, Rust or C++.
• Linux, containers, Kubernetes, networking, storage and distributed-systems fundamentals.
• GPU observability and performance analysis across engine, system and accelerator metrics.
• Model formats, quantisation, tokenisation and OpenAI-compatible serving APIs.
• Traffic management, streaming, overload protection, health checking and failure recovery.
• Integration with existing identity, authorisation, secrets and workload-isolation systems.
• Clear technical writing, design review, incident response and cross-team communication.
Nice to have
• Contributions to KServe, vLLM, SGLang or adjacent inference, gateway or orchestration projects.
• Experience modifying engine internals, profiling kernels or diagnosing CUDA and collective-communication issues.
• Experience with mixture-of-experts models, expert parallelism, speculative decoding or disaggregated serving.
• Experience routing by data-sensitivity policy, evaluation signals or multi-model review workflows.
• Experience with model serving in customer-operated, regulated or fully disconnected environments.
• Familiarity with Kata Containers, confidential computing or strong multi-workload isolation.
• Experience integrating serving with post-training rollouts and evaluation workloads.

Last time we hired for this role, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:
- CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!
- Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
- Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Company Description
At QIMA, we are on a mission to help our clients make products consumers can trust. We have developed compliance solutions for testing, inspection and certification (TIC) that enable supply chain agility, sustainability and product innovation. Our services are used by 30,000 businesses globally in the consumer products, agri-food and life sciences industries. Backed by 6,000+ dedicated Qimates worldwide, we bring local expertise and tailored support to every client. Our passion for service has made QIMA an industry leader for customer satisfaction, as highlighted by our exceptional Net Promoter Score (NPS).
Through our Life Sciences activities, we develop and deliver scientific testing and research services for our clients.
We are now launching a new programme to develop virtual pharmacology models. These models will use the data generated through years of laboratory work to help assess the efficacy of molecules and support future screening activities.
Job Description
We are looking for a Lead Data Scientist – Virtual Models to take ownership of this programme from the start.
This is a hands-on role for an experienced data scientist who wants to build something new. You will assess existing datasets across QIMA’s Business Units, identify the most promising opportunities, develop proof-of-concept models and prepare them for use by internal teams and, ultimately, by clients.
Initial applications may include models related to:
skin;
hair follicles;
longevity;
prostate cancer;
immunology.
You will work closely with Managing Directors, laboratory scientists and QIMA’s IT and AI experts. Scientific validation will be carried out in collaboration with independent laboratory teams.
Key responsibilities
Review and assess proposals from QIMA’s Business Units.
Examine the underlying data in detail, including its quality, structure, consistency, depth and breadth.
Recommend one or two models with the strongest potential for development, subject to approval by the CEO of QIMA Life Sciences.
Build and manage the required data pipelines.
Clean, structure, integrate and analyse complex biological datasets.
Develop machine learning models and proof of concepts.
Identify data gaps and recommend additional experiments where needed. Work with laboratory scientists to help define these experiments, including the required data, measurements and quality criteria.
Establish clear validation criteria and prepare models for independent scientific validation.
Improve the models through repeated testing and iteration.
Ensure that code, data and models are reproducible, traceable and properly documented.
Present results clearly to scientific, technical, commercial and non-specialist audiences.
Support the preparation of a model for future commercialisation, either as a SaaS product or as a service supporting, replacing or complementing wet-lab assays.
Contribute to the documentation and protection of intellectual property related to the models, pipelines and methods.
This role will initially be an individual contributor position. As the programme grows, you may help build and lead a team of additional data scientists.
First objectives
Within the first six months, you will be expected to:
assess the main model proposals and their underlying datasets;
recommend the one or two strongest projects;
establish a proof of concept for one or two models.
Within 12 to 15 months, the objective will be to prepare at least one model for potential commercialisation. This should include sufficient scientific validation, an interface usable internally, and complete documentation or detailed operator training.
Qualifications
You have:
a PhD in data science, biostatistics, bioinformatics, machine learning or a related field;
8–10 years of experience in data science, biostatistics and machine learning;
a proven track record of delivering complex machine learning projects using complex biological datasets;
strong experience building data pipelines, assessing data quality, identifying limitations and defining what additional data is needed;
experience working with scientists and translating scientific questions into data and modelling approaches;
excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-specialists;
ideally, experience presenting work to clients, partners or other external stakeholders;
a practical, entrepreneurial and hands-on approach;
the ability to work independently and take ownership of an ambiguous, new project.
Experience in a specific therapeutic area is not essential. The most important requirements are strong technical expertise, experience with biological data and the ability to turn complex datasets into useful, validated models.
Strong Python or R skills, including production-quality, version-controlled code. Experience with cloud data platforms (we use Snowflake) and MLOps practices.
Why join QIMA?
This is an opportunity to build a new capability from the ground up and shape how QIMA uses its biological data. You will have direct access to senior leadership, laboratory experts and technical teams, with the autonomy to define the approach and deliver tangible results.
The role will be based in Europe and will require travel, depending on project needs, to QIMA laboratories in France, Northern Ireland and Germany.
Additional Information
Does this describe you? Then we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Apply now with your CV in English and we can write the next chapter of the QIMA story together!

General Summary:
The HR Audit, Controls and Compliance Manager serves as the central point of accountability for HR audits, regulatory compliance, and control governance. The manager coordinates and maintains HR’s audit, controls, and compliance program, partnering with HR, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, IT, Finance, and external auditors to ensure HR processes, systems, and data meet industry standards, regulatory expectations, and emerging legal requirements. This position requires strong global expertise, particularly in the European regulatory landscape
The role leads end-to-end audit cycles, drives remediation and continuous improvement, and monitors developments in employment law and data privacy. It is also directly involved in supporting industry certifications, including ISO, NIST, TISAX, NCA, etc. The manager oversees a broad range of HR-focused audits and compliance reviews, including internal audits, SOX and SOC reviews, external audits, statutory audits, and government reviews, while strengthening the HR control environment, safeguarding sensitive data, and promoting a proactive approach to compliance.
Success in this role requires a strong understanding of audit principles, internal controls, risk assessment, employment law, data privacy, and regulatory compliance (e.g. ESG, CSRD etc.). The ideal candidate must demonstrate strategic thinking, sound judgment, and the ability to translate complex requirements into practical, sustainable solutions. Additional skills include strong project and change management, analytical and root-cause analysis, clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to influence, collaborate with, and lead diverse cross-functional stakeholders. Audit Ownership and Coordination
* Lead HR-related audits and external assessments. Conduct risk assessments of the HR control environment, document results, and escalate significant issues.

* Serve as the primary liaison between auditors and HR teams, ensuring requirements and responses are clear, accurate, and timely.
* Lead periodic walkthroughs with functional partners and auditors, and maintain process flowcharts, narratives, risk and control matrices, and related documentation.

* Strengthen and standardize controls across HR functions.
* Assess control deficiencies, perform root-cause analysis, recommend practical corrective actions, and track findings through closure.
* Monitor remediation and follow up on overdue or at-risk actions.
* Support internal, external, technical, and government audits and develop sustainable risk-mitigation strategies.
* Drive continuous improvement through the development and maintenance of policies, procedures, and training.

Job Title: Data Centre Architect Reports to: Head of Data Centre Development
Location: UK hybrid Company Overview:
Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.
We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.
We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.
As we scale, we’re building this organisation from the ground up. We’re looking for people who’d rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of team you’ve previously managed.
This is a senior individual contributor role with authority to sign off technical schedules, working with cluster and network architects, NVIDIA and other OEM engineers, colocation provider engineering and sales teams, and the internal Procurement, Legal, Finance and Site Operations teams.
What You’ll Do
You will be the single technical authority between our GPU-as-a-service business and the colocation providers that host our NVIDIA clusters. You turn cluster architecture and OEM requirements into a precise, contractable statement of work (SOW) for the data centre white space, then hold the provider to it through design, installation and acceptance.
We are growing from tens of megawatts to hundreds, on rack-scale liquid-cooled platforms at 130 kW per rack and rising to 200 kW and beyond. Mistakes in power, cooling or fibre specification show up as stranded capacity, delayed cluster delivery and disputes, so the role carries real commercial weight.
Key Responsibilities
Technical negotiation with colocation providers
- Lead technical due diligence on candidate sites: power availability and energisation dates, redundancy topology, liquid-cooling capability, floor loading, rack logistics, fibre and meet-me access.
- Negotiate the technical schedules of the colocation agreement with commercial and legal: capacity and density commitments, power and cooling SLAs, temperature and flow envelopes, metering, expansion rights, change control and remedies.
- Challenge provider claims with evidence: single-line diagrams, P&IDs, load-bank and commissioning records, reference customers.
Specification & SOW
- Work with cluster architects and OEMs (NVIDIA first) to capture rack, power, cooling, network and layout requirements, and keep them current across product generations.
- Write and own the technical SOW for white-space fitout: containment and cooling interfaces, power distribution to rack, structured cabling and pathways, rack and POD layout, security zoning, labelling and records.
- Define clear scope boundaries and responsibilities between us, the colocation provider, OEMs and installation contractors, with no gaps and no overlaps.
- Maintain a requirements baseline with traceability from OEM document, to SOW clause, to acceptance test.
Design, installation & acceptance
- Review provider and contractor designs, shop drawings and method statements against the SOW; run design reviews and close findings.
- Define acceptance: factory and site tests, liquid flush and cleanliness, power quality, thermal performance at full load, fibre loss, burn-in, and the evidence pack needed for each gate.
- Attend key witness tests and sign off, or reject, completion of each phase before hardware is energised.
- Manage technical change requests and variations, and advise on cost and schedule impact.
Knowledge & standards
- Build reusable reference designs, SOW templates and a site-scoring framework so each new deployment starts from a proven baseline.
- Track the roadmap: higher rack densities, 800 VDC distribution, new cooling classes and optics, and tell the business early what it means for sites already contracted.
Deliverables You Own:
- Site technical assessment: Scored, evidence-based report per candidate site, comparable across providers, with risks and mitigations.
- Technical schedules to the colocation agreement: Measurable commitments, tested in acceptance, with remedies agreed by legal.
- Cluster white-space SOW: Complete enough that a contractor can price and build without asking us questions; traceable to OEM requirements.
- Reference designs and layouts: Rack, row and POD layouts, power and cooling single-line and P&ID level interfaces, fibre pathways and densities.
- Acceptance test plan and evidence pack: Pass and fail criteria set before work starts; signed results per gate.
- Requirements baseline and change log: One current version of the truth, with every variation recorded and costed.
- Risk and issues register: Technical risks to schedule and capacity, with owners and dates.
Working Relationships:
- Cluster and network architects: You translate their cluster design into facility requirements, and they rely on you to say what a site can and cannot carry.
- OEMs, mainly NVIDIA: You are the facility-side counterpart; you obtain, interpret and challenge site-requirement documents.
- Colocation providers: Day-to-day technical counterpart through negotiation, build and acceptance.
- Procurement, legal and finance: You provide the technical substance of commercial terms and the impact of variations.
- Site operations and deployment teams: You hand over a clean specification and acceptance evidence, and take back lessons learned.
What You Bring:
- 8 or more years in data centre design, delivery or technical consulting, including at least 3 years on high-density (50 kW per rack or more) or liquid-cooled deployments.
- Direct experience writing or reviewing technical specifications and SOWs for white-space fitout, and managing contractors against them to acceptance.
- Strong working knowledge of data centre power: MV and LV distribution, UPS and generator topologies, redundancy models (N+1, 2N, distributed), busway and rack power, metering and power quality.
- Strong working knowledge of cooling: direct-to-chip liquid cooling, CDUs, facility and technology loops, warm-water and dry-cooler designs, fluid quality and flushing, leak detection and containment.
- Working knowledge of structured cabling and pathways for large GPU fabrics (single-mode optics, high fibre counts, InfiniBand and Ethernet physical layers), and of rack and POD layouts.
- Familiarity with NVIDIA rack-scale platforms (GB200 or GB300 class, or later) and their facility requirements, and the ability to read OEM site-requirement documents critically.
- Proven ability to run technical negotiations with colocation or construction counterparties, and to explain trade-offs to commercial, legal and executive audiences.
- Command of standards such as EN 50600 and the Uptime Tier framework, ASHRAE TC 9.9 liquid-cooling guidance, and commissioning practice (levels 1 to 5).
- Excellent written communication: you produce clear, unambiguous contract-grade documents.
Preferred Skills (Nice to Have):
- Experience at a hyperscaler, neocloud or colocation provider on the operator or customer side.
- Experience with 800 VDC or other DC distribution, large battery storage, or power smoothing for AI load swings.
- Chartered engineer status or equivalent; recognised data centre credentials (for example CDCP, CDFOM, Uptime ATD or AOS).
- Familiarity with BIM, digital-twin tools and requirements-management tools.
- Willingness to travel up to 30% to sites in the UK, Europe and the US.
Success Measures:
- First 90 days: Audit current colocation contracts and SOWs and list technical gaps; publish a requirements baseline for the current NVIDIA platform; take over technical lead on one live negotiation; agree the site-scoring framework with the cluster architects.
- 6 months: One complete SOW issued and priced with no material scope disputes; acceptance plan agreed with the provider before build starts; reusable SOW template adopted by the team.
- 12 months: Every new site contracted on the template with traceable requirements; clusters accepted on schedule with no facility-caused performance issues; fewer late variations and a measurable cut in time from site shortlist to signed technical schedule.
Qualities we look for:
- Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up.
- Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change.
- You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.
- Get stuck in: You’d rather be building than overseeing. Our strategy will keep evolving, and so will you — attitude and adaptability matter more to us than a fixed playbook or a big team behind you.
Package & Process:
- Employment type: Full-time, permanent.
- Travel: Up to 30%.
- Interview process: Talent Screening > Hiring Manager Screen > Technical Interview > Final with the Head of Data Centre Development.

First and foremost, we’re looking for a creative thinker, not just someone who knows how to use the software.

Has strong graphic design fundamentals, including typography, composition, hierarchy, colour and image selection.

• Is curious about what’s happening creatively outside the business and brings that thinking into their work.

You’ll become an active part of the creative conversation: someone who can sit in a meeting, understand the problem we’re trying to solve and say, “what if we did it this way?”
You’ll bring energy, personality and ideas to the team, build strong relationships with the people we work with and help us push the quality and creativity of our communications forward.

Ridge is a Built Environment Consultancy. This is all about the human-made spaces and structures that support how and where we live, work and play. Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR & IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.
By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world's top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Bedrock, and Greenoaks—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes (#12 out of 500).
What is an Employer of Record (EOR)?
An Employer of Record (EOR) is a service provider that allows companies to legally hire and work with employees in foreign countries without establishing their own legal entity in that country. This is made possible through a legal arrangement where the EOR establishes its own legal entity in the country and hires employees on behalf of the client company. This arrangement offers a viable solution for companies that wish to expand their global reach without investing in setting up a legal entity in every country where they operate.
About the Role
As an HR Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in supporting our Employer of Record service, helping companies hire and manage employees globally. You will guide clients through the employee lifecycle—from onboarding to offboarding—while addressing employee relations, claims, and compliance challenges.
Additionally, you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine workflows for hiring, onboarding, and transitions, ensuring Rippling delivers a seamless, technology-driven HR solution.
This is a unique opportunity to be a key contributor to Rippling’s growth in the UK and Ireland!
Note that this is a 3-month independent contractor position.
What you will do
• Employee Relations and Risk Mitigation: Handle complex employee relations issues, including leave management, terminations, and other matters posing regulatory risks.
• Workflow and System Setup: Collaborate with product, engineering, and compliance teams to configure and test workflows for hiring, onboarding, transitions, terminations, and statutory benefits.
• Client- and Employee-Focused Support: Respond to client and employee inquiries, develop programs and resources (e.g., help center articles, HR policies, etc.), and ensure the delivery of accurate, efficient HR services.
• Knowledge Transfer and Training: Train and coach internal HR Advisors on country-specific requirements to ensure continuity and compliance.
• Process Optimization: Design scalable, efficient processes that enhance the professionalization and delivery of HR services.
• Policy and Procedure Development: Draft and implement compliance-driven policies and detailed standard operating procedures (SOPs) for leave management, performance management, investigations, claims, terminations, unemployment benefits, workers’ compensation, and grievance investigations.
• POA: Serve as the designated Power of Attorney (POA) for the legal entity/entities they support, with responsibilities including signing employee documentation and ensuring compliance with local employment regulations.
What you will need
• 5+ years of HR Advisory, consulting, or internal HR experience covering employment and labor law matters in a fast-paced organization, across the United Kingdom and Ireland
• Deep knowledge of local labor laws, employment regulations, and cultural nuances in the United Kingdom and Ireland.
• Expertise in managing employee claims related to unemployment benefits, disability/leave benefits, workers’ compensation, and grievances.
• Demonstrated proficiency as a super-user of HRIS platforms.
• Capable of answering questions regarding pay statements and payroll basics, including tax withholdings and earnings breakdowns, and conducting simple pay-related calculations.
• Strong project management and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail and time management.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a client-focused approach.
• Professional working proficiency in English; any additional European language is a plus • Experience with benefits and pension administration is a plus.
• Experience providing HR support or managing HR processes across multiple countries is highly desirable.
Additional Information

We are looking for an energetic and inspiring People & Service Team Leader to support our store operations and lead our team to success. As a People & Service Team Leader, you will constantly strive to improve the customer journey through creating an engaged and motivated team who deliver exceptional customer service. Supporting the People & Service Manager to develop the team and maintain visual and operational standards, and in turn driving conversion, sales and KPIs.
For a more detailed overview of this role, check out the job description attached at the bottom of this advert.
## About The Role
**What You’ll Be Doing**
- Consistently deliver great service and role model this throughout the store team.
- Create a diverse and inclusive environment where all your store team feel valued.
- Create a wellbeing culture in store by being a direct line of communication for the store team.
- Confidently duty manage in all areas of the store operation including product and operations.
- Support the People & Service Manager to consistently delight customers through delivering the best customer journey across service, people, visual and operations.
- Support the People & Service Manager to empower the team within store to deliver for the customer by always putting customer experience at the centre of decision making.
- Have a good understanding of commercial tools and how to use to drive actions.
- Take accountability to drive store KPIs, including sales, stock loss, payroll, conversion, voice of customer, RFID, and people KPIs.
- Support the management of store operations, including compliance with health & safety standards.
- Support the development of the store team to deliver a high performing, motivated and engaged store team who feel valued and recognised for their contribution.
**You'll Be Perfect If**
- You have previous experience in retail, preferably in a supervisor role.
- You are passionate about fashion and stay updated on the latest trends.
- You possess strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- You can motivate and inspire a team to achieve their best.
- You are proactive, adaptable, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
- And most importantly love our products as much as we do so we create the best possible customer journey!
**Things To Consider**
- **Fast-Paced Environment:** This is a high-energy role where priorities can shift quickly based on sales performance, customer trends, and seasonal demands. You’ll need to be comfortable adapting to situations and juggling multiple tasks.
- **Reporting:** Your ability to analyse customer feedback and sales data will be crucial in driving improvements to your store.
- **Managing People:** Strong emotional intelligence is essential, as you’ll be managing a diverse team.
- **Hands-On Role:** While this position is strategic, it also requires you to be hands-on with product movement, floor resets, and physical tasks like adjusting layouts, displays, and stock replenishment.
- **Weekend Work:** As part of the retail environment, you'll need to work on weekends, public holidays, and during key seasonal periods. This is especially crucial during busy times like sales events, product launches, or store promotions.
- **Deadlines:** Strong time management skills are important for balancing multiple responsibilities and meeting deadlines.
- **Leading a Team:** Your ability to foster a positive team culture will be crucial in creating an enjoyable work environment.

job_title: Business Development Executive - Renewals and Retentions
job_description:
Overview
Would you like to help enrich the lives of learners around the world? At RM, we’ve been pioneers of education technology since 1973. We provide technology and resources to the education sector, supporting over 20 million students and improving educational outcomes worldwide.
What we do helps learners at all stages of their lives, from preschool to higher education and professional qualification; we partner with schools, examination boards, governments, and professional organisations globally to make learning more accessible, more engaging, and more impactful. RM operates through two divisions: Assessment (digital assessment and marking solutions) and Technology (managed services, hardware, and software for schools)
RM Technology has shaped future generations for over fifty years by implementing innovative technology solutions in schools and colleges. Founded in 1973, we’re a trusted Edtech partner, transforming teaching environments to be more productive, resilient, and sustainable.
Our committed team pioneer, collaborate, and continually push the bar on products and services in the EdTech space.
Visit us here to find out more: www.rm.com/education
We encourage early applications as the vacancy may close once the position has been filled or final interviews have been arranged. Responsibilities
Customer Retention & Upsell
• Develop and execute opportunities to retain existing customers by understanding their needs, identifying potential issues, and addressing concerns. Proactively engage with customers to build strong relationships and provide ongoing support and guidance.
• Build knowledge of our product and service set, alongside common needs of customers, and how the two connect.
• Identify opportunities to upsell and promote multi-year contracts to existing customers. Present compelling value propositions, negotiate contract terms, and persuade customers to extend their commitment.
• Deliver on completion of the renewal cycle, offering advice and guidance, providing pricing, dealing with questions, closing the opportunity, and submitting the renewal into processing for service.
Issue Resolution
• Act as a point of contact for customer concerns, problems, or escalations. Listen actively, empathize with customers, and work towards prompt and satisfactory resolutions. Collaborate with relevant teams to ensure timely response and resolution.
Customer Feedback Analysis
• Collect and analyse customer feedback to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. Collaborate with internal teams to implement enhancements or modifications to products, services, or processes based on customer input.
Support for General Enquiries
• Provide support and cover for other colleagues within the Customer Contact centre, if required
Experience
You will have experience of:
• Working within a customer environment, understanding their needs and requirements.
You will be:
• An enthusiastic, articulate and effective communicator, able to demonstrate to potential customers how RM’s solutions can meet their needs.
• A strong collaborator, willing to bring your best to the team for collective success.
• An independent operator, confident to assess how best to work with customers to meet the growth figures. • Confident communicating through writing, informal speech and presentation.
• Comfortable working with and analysing numbers.
You will have:
• Good analytical and judgement and decision-making skills, which you'll use to qualify opportunities and assess how to convert them. You may have a degree level qualification or have gained these skills in other ways.
• Excellent relationship-building skills with the ability to understand and meet customer needs. Demonstrated ability to engage and communicate effectively with customers at various levels within organizations.
• Strong planning & organising skills, which you’ll use to effectively manage your pipeline.
• Results orientation, with passion for achievement against objectives, targets and KPIs.
• Flexible can-do attitude with a willingness and ability to adapt and learn within the role.
• Strong alignment to RM's core behaviours: Be Brave, Win Together, Be Curious, Make it Simple and Consider it Done.
What’s in it for you? At RM we recently introduced My Work Blend @RM which provides office-based colleagues with multi location and hybrid working options to suit them. As well as your office base, you can spend a proportion of your time working at other locations that suit your role and your life, including home, other offices, customer sites, distribution centres or on the move. We encourage you to discuss arrangements for this role with your potential line manager during the recruitment process. We expect how we make best use of hybrid working may continue to adapt as we adjust to our new ways of working. At RM we are committed to making the recruitment process as inclusive as possible for everyone. Should you require additional support with your application or through the interview process, please contact us at recruitment@rm.com. As well as a competitive salary and our core benefits package which includes private medical healthcare, life assurance and a Group Personal Pension Plan with higher contribution levels available, some roles are also eligible for a performance-related bonus. There are lots of voluntary benefits too. You could buy additional annual leave, join our dental plan, sign for a health assessment, or take part in our cycle to work scheme. You could even earn yourself an extra bonus for successfully recommending a friend or family member for a position within RM. The role and its responsibilities can be expected to evolve across time.

Job Summary:
Title: Graphic Designer - Sports International
Location: London, UK (In-office 5 days a week) Working Hours: Full time
Contract Type: Permanent
The Role:
Roc Nation Sports International is seeking a Graphic Designer to serve as a key member of the creative team. You’ll be responsible for creating high-quality, culturally relevant, social-first design and motion assets for:
RNSI’s own channels
Our athletes
Our consulting clients and partners
This is a hands-on, fast-paced role working across reactive social content, campaign launches, long-term brand projects and pitch materials. You’ll work closely with marketing, social, content, PR and leadership to help continually elevate the creative standard of everything we put into the world.
Core Responsibilities
Create high-quality, engaging visual assets for RNSI’s social and digital channels
Design content for our athletes, clubs and brand partners
Develop original design concepts that push the RNSI visual identity forward
Execute both reactive social content and longer-term campaign creative
Work closely with social, marketing and content teams to ensure cultural relevance and speed
Maintain a high bar for craft, detail, consistency and storytelling
Help evolve the overall look, feel and ambition of RNSI’s output
Requirements
2+ years industry experience and a portfolio demonstrating capabilities and creative flair
Highly proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects; Premiere a plus)
Strong understanding of social media platforms, formats and trends
Excellent attention to detail and ability to work at speed in a high-output environment
Strong sense of design, typography, layout, composition and motion
Knowledge of sport, particularly football and rugby, and its connection to culture and lifestyle
Comfortable working across multiple projects at once
Eager to learn, improve and continuously level up creatively
Motion design / video-first social experience
Ability to think conceptually, not just execute
The Type of Person We’re Looking For
You care about culture, not just design
You want to be part of a team building something special
You want ownership, responsibility and growth
You’re excited by the idea of helping build a best-in-class in-house creative function
Why This Role Is Special
You’ll work directly on top-tier athletes, global brands and major sporting moments
You’ll have huge creative exposure and responsibility

Bank and Payment Rail Integrations

You can be based from any of our Store Support Centres (Coventry, London or
Manchester), with a mix of home and office working.
Why join us
Every decision about where and how Sainsbury's grows draws on spatial data, and
on the tools that turn that data into insight. Our Location & Portfolio Planning
team builds and runs those tools. We give our Location Planners, the Property
team and the wider business the maps, apps and data products they need to make
decisions at pace. As our Spatial Data Analyst, you'll help shape what our
products show and the data that powers them.
What you'll do
You'll work closely with our Senior Spatial Analyst (your manager) and our
Senior Spatial Data Science Engineer to develop, maintain and monitor the data,
tools and apps our planners rely on. You'll build new products in ArcGIS,
Tableau, Alteryx and Excel that improve location insight and support decision
making. You'll also look after our in-house apps, macros, ESRI service layers
and enterprise GIS platform. When something needs fixing, you'll be the go-to
person, troubleshooting technical issues and handling data requests from
colleagues across Sainsbury's.
 Alongside creating geospatial outputs, you'll develop the pipelines,
integration and quality controls that feed our mapping and location planning
tools, using Alteryx and SQL to automate how data flows through them. You'll
spend time with Location Planners to understand how they work, act on their
feedback and design intuitive solutions. You'll also create clear documentation
and training that helps the whole team build its skills. You'll keep up with
developments in spatial analytics and bring in new ideas, and there's real scope
to shape the role around your interests.
Who you are
You understand spatial data and the complexities of handling it, and you have
working knowledge of GIS systems, ideally ESRI products. You're numerate and
logical, you enjoy solving problems and using data to support decisions, and
you're comfortable working on your own: planning your workload, managing
projects and meeting deadlines. Experience with Alteryx, Tableau, SQL,
Snowflake, VBA, Python or GitHub would be a real plus, but we'll provide
training. Retail experience and confidence presenting to stakeholder groups
would be an advantage. 
Essential criteria
* Demonstrable working knowledge of GIS systems (ideally ESRI products such as
ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online/Enterprise), including evidence of handling and
managing spatial data.
* Evidence of using data, analysis or visualisation to solve problems and
support decision-making.
* Proven ability to plan, prioritise and deliver your own projects and workload
to agreed deadlines.
* Demonstrable experience creating clear documentation, supporting materials or
training that help others use data, tools or products.
RESPONSIBILITIES
We’d all like amazing work to do, and real work-life balance. That’s waiting for
you at Sainsbury’s. For a FTSE business, we move incredibly fast. When we’re not
handling projects, we’re helping all corners of the wider group with what
they’re trying to achieve. And around here, you can see the results of your work
as soon as you walk into a store, which gives you a real sense of purpose and
responsibility. Better still, the team around you will listen to your ideas and
opinions, and you’ll have every chance to try something new. The sheer scale and
complexity of our set-up means there’s always something else around the corner,
and we’ll help and support you every step of the way. We’re trusted to get on
with it. So get ready to make things happen here.
QUALIFICATIONS
We are committed to being a truly inclusive retailer, so you’ll be welcomed
whoever you are and wherever you work. Around here, there’s always the chance to
try something new - whether that’s as part of an evolving team or somewhere else
across the business - and we take development seriously and promise to support
you. We also recognise and celebrate colleagues when they go the extra mile and,
where possible, offer flexible working. When you join our team, we’ll also offer
you an amazing range of benefits. Here are some of them:
 
 Starting off with colleague discount, you'll be able to get 10% off at
Sainsbury's, Argos, TU and Habitat after 4 weeks. This increases to 15% off at
Sainsbury’s every Friday and Saturday and 15% off at Argos every pay day. We've
also got you covered for your future with our pensions scheme and life cover.
You'll also be able to share in our success as you may be eligible for a
performance-related bonus of up to 10% of salary, depending on how we perform.  
 
 Your wellbeing is important to us too. You'll receive an annual holiday
allowance, and you can buy additional holiday. We also offer other benefits that
will help your money go further such as season ticket loans, cycle to work
scheme, health cash plans, pay advance (where you can access some of your pay
before pay day) as well access to a great range of discounts from hundreds of
other retailers. And if you ever need it there is also an employee assistance
programme.
 
 Moments that matter are as important to us as they are to you which is why we
give up to 26 weeks’ pay for maternity or adoption leave and up to 4 weeks’ pay
for paternity leave. 
 
 Please see www.sainsburys.jobs for a range of our benefits (note, length of
service and eligibility criteria may apply).

job_title: Associate Validation Engineer – High-Speed Validation & Signal Integrity
job_description:
Location: Bristol, UK Hybrid: Office: Monday – Thursday
Our Team
Fancy a career at the sharp end of how the world actually connects? Join an ambitious and collaborative engineering team at the cutting edge of global data communications.
Based in Bristol, we work closely with a world-renowned design group to develop advanced semiconductor solutions that power the digital infrastructure of tomorrow. Our culture is open, inclusive, and driven by innovation — and as a graduate joining us, you won't be making the coffee - You'll be in the lab, hands-on, from week one.
Job Summary
Ready to turn your degree into a career that actually matters? As a Graduate High-Speed Validation Engineer, you'll be trained up to test and validate next-generation semiconductor devices that are shaping the future of global connectivity — the chips inside the networks that move the world's data.
No two days will look the same: one week you might be in new product design meetings helping shape how a device gets tested, the next you'll be in the lab taking real measurements on components running at 10Gbit/s and beyond.
You'll learn from experienced engineers who genuinely want to see you grow, get hands-on with industry-leading test equipment, and pick up skills — from Python/LabVIEW automation to high-speed signal integrity — that will set you up for a serious engineering career.
This is your launchpad. Bring the curiosity and work ethic; we'll bring the mentorship, the kit, and the opportunity.
Responsibilities
• Support new product design meetings and help develop test approaches for evaluating new products
• Assist in building validation solutions for new products — covering software, hardware, and documentation
• Help identify the right bench-top test equipment for validating new products
• Learn to build test automation software using Python or LabVIEW
• Work closely with designers, product, test, and applications engineers as part of a genuinely collaborative team
• Take part in validation review meetings and contribute your findings
• Help create clear, accurate validation reports
• Get hands-on testing high-speed optical components, ICs, and modules
• Take high-speed lab measurements on products operating at data rates of 10Gbit/s and above
• Build your knowledge of high-speed signal integrity, including exposure to schematic entry/layout using Altium PCB tools
Minimum Qualifications
• BSc/MSc in Electrical/Electronic Engineering (EE/ECE) or a closely related discipline
• 0–2 years' relevant experience — this role is designed for recent graduates ready to build their career in high-speed validation
• A genuine curiosity for electronics, test, and measurement, and a willingness to learn fast
• Able to stay focused and positive in a fast-paced, dynamic R&D environment
• A natural team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and asking questions
• Good interpersonal and communication skills
• Strong self-motivation — comfortable picking up new tools and techniques independently
• An analytical mindset, attention to detail, and a creative approach to problem-solving
Career Growth Philosophy
At Semtech, we believe that innovation starts with people — and that includes the people just starting out. That's why we're committed to empowering your professional development through mentorship, structured learning, and a collaborative, idea-rich environment from day one.
Our pay-for-performance culture rewards initiative and celebrates meaningful contributions, no matter how early in your career you are. Join us, and be part of a team that's building the future of connectivity — together.

job_title: Senior Staff Engineer – High-Speed Validation & Signal Integrity
job_description:
Location: Bristol, UK Hybrid: Office: Monday – Thursday
Our Team
Fancy being at the sharp end of how the world actually connects? Join an ambitious and collaborative engineering team at the cutting edge of global data communications.
Based in Bristol, we work closely with a world-renowned design group to develop advanced semiconductor solutions that power the digital infrastructure of tomorrow. Our culture is open, inclusive, and driven by innovation. Here, your ideas matter, your expertise is valued, and your work has a real-world impact — on the chips inside the networks that move the world’s data.
Job Summary
Think you’ve seen it all in the lab? This role will put that to the test.
As a Senior Staff Engineer – High-Speed Validation & Signal Integrity, you won’t just be running test plans someone else wrote — you’ll be shaping how next-generation semiconductor devices get validated before they ever reach the hyperscale data centres and networks that depend on them. This is deep, technically demanding work at data rates of 10Gbit/s and beyond, where the margin for error is measured in picoseconds and the stakes are measured in billions of connected devices.
No two days will look the same: one week you’re in new product design meetings, driving the test strategy for a device that doesn’t exist anywhere else in the world yet; the next you’re elbow-deep in the lab, pulling real signal integrity data out of silicon that’s pushing the boundaries of what’s physically possible.
You’ll have the technical credibility to be heard in the room, the autonomy to own your validation solutions end-to-end, and the kind of influence that shapes not just how a product is tested — but how it’s designed to be testable in the first place. If you’re the engineer other people come to when something doesn’t make sense in the data, this is where that expertise finally gets the platform it deserves.
This is senior-level validation work for someone who wants to lead from the bench, mentor the next generation of engineers, and help define the technologies the world will be running on for the next decade.
Responsibilities
• Drive test feature development and strategy in new product design meetings, shaping how next-generation devices get evaluated
• Architect validation solutions for new products end-to-end — software, hardware, and documentation
• Identify and specify the bench-top test equipment needed to validate cutting-edge products
• Build sophisticated test automation software using Python or LabVIEW
• Collaborate closely with designers, product, test, and applications engineers as a trusted technical voice
• Lead validation review meetings and influence key product decisions
• Produce clear, authoritative validation reports that others rely on
• Get hands-on testing high-speed optical components, ICs, and modules at the bleeding edge of the industry
• Take precision lab measurements on products operating at data rates of 10Gbit/s and above
• Apply deep, hard-won knowledge of high-speed signal integrity to schematic entry and layout using Altium PCB tools
Minimum Qualifications
• BSc/MSc in Electrical/Electronic Engineering (EE/ECE) or a closely related discipline (or HNC/HND with equivalent work experience)
• 6+ years of relevant experience in high-speed validation or lab-based test engineering
• A proven ability to thrive under pressure in a fast-paced, high-stakes R&D environment
• A natural collaborator who elevates the people around them
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to influence across technical and business audiences
• A relentless self-starter, comfortable mastering new tools and techniques independently
• Sharp analytical and problem-solving instincts, with an obsessive attention to detail
• A creative, innovative approach to engineering challenges others might walk away from
Why Join Us?
• Work on products that quite literally power the infrastructure connecting the world — from hyperscale data centres to 5G and PON networks
• Join a world-class validation team where your technical judgement genuinely shapes product direction
• Be part of a global organisation big enough to offer real international scope, yet agile enough for your individual impact to be felt and recognised
• Collaborate with some of the sharpest engineering minds in the industry, across Bristol and our international partner sites
• Enjoy a competitive, pay-for-performance compensation package that rewards the expertise you bring to the table
Career Growth Philosophy
At Semtech, we believe that innovation starts with people — and that includes those who’ve already built real expertise and want to keep sharpening it.
That’s why we’re committed to empowering your professional development through mentorship, continued learning, and a collaborative, idea-rich environment at every stage of your career.
Our pay-for-performance culture rewards initiative and celebrates meaningful contributions, however senior you are. Join us, and be part of a team that’s building the future of connectivity — together.

At Siemens, we help organizations transform maintenance and operations through connected insights, AI-powered technology, and intelligent asset management solutions. Description:
Are you a visionary Product Leader with a passion for transforming how organizations manage the entire lifecycle of their assets? Do you thrive on shaping strategy, driving innovation, and making a tangible impact in multiple segments across government and infrastructure? In this high-impact, global position, you will be the strategic force behind our asset management software and AI-powered solutions tailored for asset lifecycle management. You will own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from definition of the long-term vision and multi-year roadmap to ensuring successful execution and market adoption. This is an opportunity to elevate our entire offering from a product-centric approach to a powerful, vertical-focused solution that truly resonates with the diverse needs of asset-intensive organizations.
You’ll make an impact by
This role offers a unique opportunity to blend an AI-led strategic vision with hands-on execution, making a tangible impact on organizations around the world. Your responsibilities will include:
Strategic Vision and Portfolio Management
* Market Whitespace Identification: Look beyond the current roadmap to identify new market categories or disruptive shifts.
* Portfolio Balancing: Managing a mix of mature products, high-growth products, and R&D to ensure long-term business viability.
* Resource Allocation: Making the hard trade-offs between competing product lines to maximize overall ROI for the company.
Financial Acumen (P&L Responsibility)
* P&L Management: Understand the levers of revenue, Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)—especially relevant in cloud/SaaS margins—and operating expenses.
* Pricing and Packaging: Move beyond simple cost-plus pricing to value-based pricing and complex licensing models (e.g., transitioning from perpetual to subscription).
* Business Case Development: Build the financial justification for major investments, acquisitions, or pivots.
Go-to-Market (GTM) Leadership
* Sales Enablement at Scale: Partnering with global sales leaders to ensure the sales force can effectively position the product's value proposition.
* Ecosystem and Channel Strategy: Understanding how to leverage partners, integrators, and marketplaces to expand reach without linear headcount growth.
* Customer Success Alignment: Ensuring the product strategy accounts for retention and expansion, not just initial acquisition.
Organizational Influence and Stakeholder Management
* Executive Presence: The ability to distill complex product challenges into business risks and opportunities for the C-suite or Board.
* Cross-functional Orchestration: Aligning Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Finance around a single "North Star" metric.
* Change Management: Leading the organization through transitions, such as adopting Agile at scale or shifting to a platform-centric model.
This is how you'll win us over 
* Significant experience of progressive product management experience, preferably within SaaS, asset management, infrastructure/facilities planning, or closely related fields.
* Significant experience in government infrastructure markets (local or national government, contractor, and/or local authorities)
* Proven track record of defining, launching, and iterating on products that deliver measurable results, drive significant product adoption, and contribute directly to revenue growth.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial and operational data, as well as critically evaluate AI-generated insights (e.g., predictions, confidence levels, trade-offs) to inform product decisions.
* Demonstrable experience in leading and influencing cross-functional teams from concept through successful delivery, without direct managerial authority. You can align diverse groups towards a common product vision.
* Communicates clearly, concisely, and proactively; surfaces risks early, navigates difficult conversations with candor and tact, and adapts complex information for different audiences.
* Anticipates challenges, breaks complex problems into actionable steps, and develops practical, creative solutions rather than simply identifying obstacles.
* Takes full accountability for outcomes, follows through on commitments, addresses mistakes quickly with solutions, and works beyond role boundaries when needed to drive team and business success.
* Ability and willingness to travel internationally for onsite client visits, customer-centric events, and industry conferences, as needed.
You'll Thrive Even More If You Also Bring
* Portfolio Ownership & Accountability: Prior experience managing a product portfolio with clear accountability for its performance, strategic direction, and successful delivery.
* AI-Forward Visionary: Practical use of AI to help perform market research, and develop product requirements, as well as consideration of how AI can be used inside the products to increase efficiency and usability
* Pragmatic Decision-Making: A proven ability to make pragmatic decisions that effectively balance the unique objectives of the public sector, technological constraints, and complex interdependencies.
* Executive Presence & Credibility: Possess strong executive presence and credibility, enabling effective engagement with senior leadership, government officials, and key industry partners.
* Innovation & Business Model Transformation: A track record of thinking beyond current offerings, identifying new opportunities, and driving business model innovation within the product space.
* Customer-Centric Engagement: An exceptional client service ethic and comfort engaging confidently with leaders across municipalities, counties, educational institutions, and other public entities.
* M&A Integration Experience: Experience with Mergers & Acquisitions integration, including process/strategy integration, cultural alignment, and building cross-geographical teams.

• Support accident and near-miss reviews and potential RIDDOR reporting.
• Support CQC, NHS contract, internal and ISO assurance activity.
• Work with clinical and technical specialists where specialist advice is required, including areas such as infection prevention, clinical waste, sharps and medical equipment.

• Support inductions, onboarding, offboarding, access and workstation arrangements.

• Promote ownership, transparency, constructive challenge and continuous improvement across teams and sites.

We are looking for someone who is approachable, practical, proactive, resilient, discreet and highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the confidence to take ownership.

• Experience in office, facilities, operations or administration management within a medium-sized or larger organisation.
• Experience managing facilities, maintenance, contractors and/or landlord relationships.

# Who You Are
We're looking for a **Senior Backend Engineer** who thrives in high-ownership environments and knows what it takes to build, ship, and operate distributed systems at scale, not just design them.
You’ll help build and scale a product that relies on reliable, high-throughput backend services and strong operational maturity. This is a hands-on senior role: you will design, code, ship, operate, and continuously improve distributed systems in production.
You're someone who has seen production fail, learned from it, and built better systems because of it. You care about observability, reliability, and code quality not as checkboxes but as craft. You're comfortable with ambiguity, collaborative by nature, and you raise the bar for the engineers around you.
## What you’ll do
- **Design and implement distributed backend systems**: services that are resilient, observable, and scalable (latency, throughput, reliability).
- **Build event-driven and asynchronous architectures** using queues, pub/sub, background workers, and idempotent processing.
- **Own production reliability**: performance tuning, incident response, on-call participation (if applicable), and systematic improvements (SLOs, error budgets, runbooks).
- **Raise the engineering bar**: lead by example in code quality, API design, testing strategy, and operational best practices.
- **Deeply instrument services** with logs, metrics, and traces; help standardize observability patterns across the platform.
- **Partner with Product and other engineers** to define success metrics, measure impact, and iterate quickly based on real usage.
- **Mentor and guide**: review designs and PRs, support other engineers, and shape long-term technical direction.
### **Specifically, we’re looking for**
- **Senior experience (typically 8+ years)** building and operating backend systems in production.
- **Strong coding skills in Go** (production-grade, not scripting).
- **Distributed systems fundamentals**: concurrency, backpressure, retries, idempotency, consistency tradeoffs, schema evolution, failure modes.
- **Cloud and infrastructure maturity** (AWS preferred): designing services with managed cloud components, scaling patterns, cost awareness.
- **Kubernetes and Docker** experience: containerized services, deployments, operational workflows.
- **Observability expertise**: traces, metrics, logs, dashboards, alerting, incident analysis (Datadog and/or OpenTelemetry experience is a plus).
- **Databases**: strong PostgreSQL skills (schema design, indexing, query tuning) plus comfort working with OpenSearch and modern data stores.
- **Engineering rigor**: testing strategies (unit, integration, contract), CI/CD hygiene, safe rollout patterns (feature flags, canaries, gradual releases).
### Bonus
- Experience with **queueing and streaming systems** (SQS, SNS, Kafka, Kinesis, RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub).
- **Vector databases** and retrieval patterns (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant, OpenSearch vector).
- Redis, MongoDB (only if truly used and not just “resume keywords”).
- Terraform (or equivalent IaC), GitHub Actions (or similar CI/CD).
- Security basics for backend systems (authn/authz, secrets management, least privilege, threat-aware design).
## What success looks like
- Services that are easier to operate: clear SLOs, better alerts, faster incident resolution.
- Higher throughput and lower latency as usage grows.
- Stronger platform foundations: repeatable patterns for async processing, observability, and safe deployments.
- A team that levels up through your mentorship and technical leadership.
### Ideally, you are someone that
- Has previously worked in startups - comfortable navigating some uncertainty and high energy environments
- Enjoys the collaborative process with different roles to design, implement and iterate on possible ideas and solutions
- Is not a perfectionist but has a mindset of continuous, incremental improvements towards top-quality work
- Is great at communicating with engineers, product managers, and other team members
- Bonus:
- Worked in the SalesTech space
### Our Process
We want to be mindful of your time while finding the right candidate for our team. No homework to do, only human interactions ! Our typical recruitment timelines looks like this:
- **Screening call** with Talent Acquisition (30 minutes) - to know more about you and go deeper about the role
- **Technical fit call** with CTO (30 minutes) - to get to know each other, know about your technical depth.
- Virtual Onsite Session :
- Coding Session (1 hour) : In this hands-on session, you'll pair with our engineers to solve a real-world problem, focusing on clean logic, maintainability, and how you think through edge cases in real-time.
- System Design Interview (1 hour) : We’ll dive into a whiteboard session to explore how you architect scalable systems, specifically looking at your ability to navigate technical trade-offs and balance performance with simplicity.
- Culture and Values Interview (30 minutes) : We’ll wrap up by exploring our core values and your working style to ensure our environment is one where you’ll feel energized, supported, and empowered to do your best work.
- Manager Interview (30 minutes) : This is a two-way conversation with your potential lead to discuss your career trajectory, how you navigate project ownership, and how we can support your growth within the team.
If all goes well, we’ll then make you an offer !
